jobs.title: Technisch Consultant / Product Engineer
jobs.description:
**Over OCTOBOX**

OCTOBOX is een innovatief softwarebedrijf dat oplossingen ontwikkelt voor centrale en lokale overheden. Onze software helpt organisaties bij het beheren van informatie, het verwerken van (gevoelige) gegevens en het voldoen aan wetgeving zoals ‘Open op Orde’ en de ‘Wet open overheid’. We maken complexe informatiehuishouding beheersbaar en toegankelijk door het automatiseren van processen rondom data\-analyse, publicatie en archivering.

Binnen OCTOBOX heerst een moderne en dynamisch cultuur waarin autonomie, innovatie en klantgerichtheid centraal staan. Ter versterking van ons team zoeken we een Technisch Consultant / Product Engineer die functionele ontwerpen weet te vertalen naar slimme technische oplossingen binnen onze low\-code product platform.

**Jouw rol** 

Als Product Engineer ben jij de technische schakel binnen onze projectteams. Je vertaalt functionele ontwerpen door gebruik te maken van onze softwaresuite naar een technische oplossingen, en realiseert maatwerk waar nodig. Je werkt met onze low\-code suite en schakelt (indien nodig) moeiteloos over op C\#\-scripting voor specifieke klantwensen. Jouw werk zorgt ervoor dat systemen correct gekoppeld zijn, data stroomt zoals bedoeld, en onze oplossingen en functionaliteiten probleemloos functioneren in de klantomgeving.

Samen met implementatieconsultants, projectmanagers en ontwikkelaars draag je bij aan een soepele en schaalbare oplevering van onze projecten – altijd binnen planning en volgens technische standaarden.

**Wat je gaat doen**

* Configureren en inrichten van onze softwareproducten op basis van low/no\-code technologie.
* Realiseren van technische maatwerkcomponenten in C\# wanneer standaardfuncties tekortschieten.
* Inrichten, testen en beheren van koppelingen met externe systemen zoals DMS’en, zaaksystemen en databronnen (via REST API’s e.a.).
* Voorbereiden en uitvoeren van technische installaties, updates en migraties.
* Vertalen van functionele specificaties naar robuuste technische implementaties.
* Signaleren en oplossen van technische issues in samenwerking met collega’s uit het ontwikkelteam.
* Documenteren van technische keuzes en inrichting voor overdraagbaarheid en beheer.
* Intensief samenwerken met projectstakeholders gedurende alle fasen van een project.
* Uitvoeren van functionele en technische tests om de kwaliteit en werking van jouw configuraties en koppelingen te waarborgen.
* Bijdragen aan het releaseproces binnen onze DevOps\-werkwijze, waaronder het voorbereiden, testen, documenteren en begeleiden van releases.

**Wat je meebrengt**

* Een afgeronde hbo\-opleiding in een technische richting (zoals Informatica of Software Engineering).
* Ervaring met low\-code of no\-code configuraties binnen softwareplatforms.
* Praktische kennis van C\#\-scripting en het bouwen van maatwerklogica.
* Ervaring met REST API’s, JSON, XML, en authenticatieprotocollen zoals OAuth of SAML.
* Bekendheid met applicatie\-installaties binnen Server/Microsoft\-omgevingen.
* Basiskennis van SQL, PowerShell of DevOps\-tools is mooi meegenomen.
* Ervaring met informatiesystemen of ECM's in de publieke sector is een pré.

**Wie jij bent**

* Een gestructureerde technicus met een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen.
* Zorgvuldig, kwaliteitsgericht en nauwkeurig in je werk.
* Een teamspeler die effectief samenwerkt met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines.
* Zelfstandig in je aanpak, met eigenaarschap over je taken.
* Leergierig en nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en methodes.
* Je vindt het belangrijk om werk te doen met maatschappelijke impactvolle waarde: je draagt graag bij aan systemen en kritische projecten die overheidsorganisaties helpen transparanter, efficiënter en betrouwbaarder te functioneren.

Soort dienstverband: Fulltime, Parttime

Salaris: €3\.000,00 \- €5\.000,00 per maand

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Auto van de zaak
* Bedrijfsfeesten
* Budget voor professionele ontwikkeling
* Extra vakantiedagen
* Kerstpakket
* Pensioen
* Reiskostenvergoeding
* Telefoon van de zaak
* Werk vanuit huis

Opleiding:

* HBO (Gewenst)

Ervaring:

* IT\-ondersteuning: 3 jaar (Gewenst)
* AI: 1 jaar (Vereist)
* SQL: 2 jaar (Vereist)
* JSON: 2 jaar (Vereist)
* Projectimplementatie: 1 jaar (Gewenst)

Taal:

* Nederlands (Vereist)

Bereidheid om zakelijk te reizen:

* 50% (Gewenst)

Werklocatie: Hybride werken in 3441 Woerden

jobs.title: Management Traineeship Engineering & Maintenance
Developer, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
HENZ ICT groeit. En dus zoeken we collega's die willen meebouwen aan ons bedrijf. Gedreven collega's die graag samenwerken en on the job willen leren. Ons vak: Netwerk Security. Wat je op feestjes vertelt: hackers buiten de deur houden. We werken dagelijks met een klein hecht team aan de complexe IT\-vraagstukken van onze klanten. Omdat we discreet zijn noemen we geen namen. Dus zijn het de grote jongens, dat snap je.

**Wat ga je doen?**  
Wij zijn gespecialiseerd in netwerkauthenticatie\-oplossingen en werken samen met F5 Networks en Radiator Software. Jij schrijft mee aan onze inhouse ontwikkelde security\- en netwerk\-applicaties. Je bouwt features en fixes, en je kijkt met een kritisch oog mee naar het werk van je collega's via code reviews. Samen met de andere developers zorg je dat de code die het team oplevert klopt en klaar is voor productie. Code is een passie voor je. Waarbij AI een tool is niet een vervanging van je skills. Zo zorgen we voor de hoge standaard die onze klanten van onze producten verwachten.

**Zo werken we**  
We werken eigenlijk altijd op projectbasis. Omdat we houden van een kop en een staart en van getting things done (daar gaan we ver in, lees: tot op de laatste millimeter). Vaak werk je samen met collega\-developers aan een of meerdere projecten. Binnen een project werk je zelfstandig aan een feature of fix, hierin krijg je veel vrijheid om het vraagstuk van de klant op te lossen. De lijnen zijn kort en ons gezamenlijke doel is om de klant zo snel en zo goed mogelijk te helpen. Keep it short \& simple, daar houden we van. Elke dag doen we een dagstart, zodat je ook weet waar je collega's aan werken. En je dus ook met elkaar kunt meedenken. Dat wordt gewaardeerd.

**Hier vind je ons**  
Ons kantoor is gevestigd in het COEN\-gebouw in Amsterdam, op loopafstand van station Sloterdijk. Iedereen werkt gemiddeld 2 dagen per week thuis en 3 op kantoor (of bij de klant als dat nodig is). Gewoon je eigen boterhammen mee tijdens de lunch, maar wel even weg van je werkplek. Je bent met techneuten onder elkaar, dus ook als er even niet gewerkt wordt, gaat het vaak over IT\-zaken. Maar we praten elkaar ook wekelijks bij over de nieuwste games en series.

**Wat bieden we?**

* Een hecht en gezellig team met ervaren en minder ervaren techneuten. Ben je eenmaal binnen, dan ga je niet zo snel meer weg. Om de drie maanden plannen we een team\-uitje voor wat extra ontspanning.
* Veel aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling. Denk aan het behalen van certificaten (o.a. F5\), kennis over informatiebeveiliging en iso 27001, de laatste security\-trends en interne begeleiding door onze eigen specialisten.
* Een goed salaris, passend bij jouw werkervaring.
* 25 vakantiedagen om uit te rusten en een goede pensioenregeling om je geen zorgen te maken over je toekomst.
* Een goede laptop die je niet tegenwerkt.

**Wat breng jij in?**

* Hbo\- of wo\-denkniveau aan de hand van een relevante IT\- of IT\-securityopleiding.
* Leergierigheid en gedrevenheid om er met elkaar iets moois van te maken.
* Je schrijft graag zelf code, maar kunt net zo goed met een kritische blik het werk van een ander reviewen.
* Je werkt goed samen en communiceert helder met je teamgenoten over voortgang en keuzes.
* Ervaring met php, javascript en/of perl is vereist.
* Ervaring met python, bash of powershell is een pré.
* Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands (must).
* Je woont in Nederland.
* Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels zijn een pré.

**Klinkt goed?**

Dan horen we graag van je! Zien we net als jij een match, dan plannen we zo snel mogelijk een eerste kennismaking.

Stuur je cv en korte motivatie naar vacature@henz.nl.

Soort dienstverband: Fulltime, Parttime, Uitzicht op vast  
Contractduur: 12 maanden

Salaris: €3\.000,00 \- €4\.500,00 per maand

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Pensioen
* Reiskostenvergoeding

Werklocatie: Hybride werken in 1014 Amsterdam

jobs.title: Platform Engineer Microsoft Dynamics CE
Application engineer Industrial Automation
jobs.description:
### **HIGHLIGHTS VAN DEZE VACATURE**


✔ Werken aan industriële automatisering bij toonaangevende klanten in Food, Chemie en Pharma. ✔ Ontwerpen, programmeren en optimaliseren van PLC\-, DCS\-, SCADA\- en MES\-oplossingen. ✔ Fulltime rol met leaseauto, ontwikkelmogelijkheden en zichtbaar resultaat in de fabriekshal.
### **DIT GA JE DOEN**


Als Application engineer Industrial Automation ga je procesbesturingssystemen ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren voor productieomgevingen in de Food \& Beverage, Oil \& Gas, Pharma en Chemie. Je werkt projectmatig voor klanten in de BENELUX, soms op locatie bij de installatie, soms vanuit het kantoor in Zeist. Jij vertaalt proceswensen naar betrouwbare automatiseringsoplossingen en ondersteunt opdrachtgevers technisch bij het gebruik en verbeteren van hun systemen. Daarbij speel je een zichtbare rol in het aansluiten van software, proceslogica en praktijk, zodat installaties correct draaien en data betrouwbaar beschikbaar is. Vanuit die rol ontwikkel je je stap voor stap tot specialist in industriële automatisering en procesoptimalisatie, met nadruk op het programmeren én het slimmer maken van automatiseringsprocessen. In de kern draait jouw werk om het realiseren, testen en verbeteren van industriële automatiseringsoplossingen voor veeleisende productieomgevingen:

  

* Programmeren van PLC\-, DCS\-, SCADA\- en MES\-applicaties voor procesbesturing.
* Opstellen van functionele specificaties op basis van klanteisen en procesdata.
* Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van besturingslogica samen met de opdrachtgever.
* Simuleren, testen en valideren van applicaties inclusief ondersteuning bij inbedrijfname.
* Geven van technische trainingen aan gebruikers en beheerders van de nieuwe software.

  

Je werkt mee aan projecten bij toonaangevende industriële klanten, variërend van optimalisatie van verpakkingslijnen tot automatisering van tankopslag en digitalisering van productieprocessen in de chemie en farma, waardoor je continu met actuele technieken en vraagstukken in industriële automatisering bezig bent.


### **DIT BRENG JE MEE**


In deze rol werk je gestructureerd, neem je eigenaarschap over je deel van het project en schakel je zorgvuldig met opdrachtgevers en collega’s. Je hebt een praktische houding, duikt graag de techniek in en blijft rustig analyseren als processen complex zijn of snel wijzigen.

  

* Afgeronde wo\-opleiding of bachelor in werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek, procestechnologie, informatica of vergelijkbaar, eventueel aangevuld met een master in Systems \& Control of Control \& Operations.
* Bereidheid om op projectbasis te werken bij klanten binnen de BENELUX, gecombineerd met inzet op inhouse\-projecten in Zeist.
* Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift voor documentatie en klantcontact.
* Ervaring of aantoonbare kennis van industriële automatisering met PLC, DCS, SCADA en MES, bijvoorbeeld via studieprojecten, stage of eerste baan.
* Sterk analytisch vermogen en probleemoplossend denken, gecombineerd met leergierigheid om nieuwe systemen en technieken zoals C\# en slimme scripts grondig te doorgronden.


### **HIER KUN JE OP REKENEN**


Als fulltime Application engineer Industrial Automation werk je aan projecten met directe impact op industriële processen.

  

* Een salaris tussen €3\.200,\- en €4\.800,\- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring in industriële automatisering.
* 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV\-dagen per jaar, passend bij een fulltime dienstverband.
* Leaseauto met tank\- of laadpas voor reizen naar klanten in de BENELUX.
* Een boeiend en afwisselend takenpakket met grote zelfstandigheid en direct zichtbare resultaten van je werk in industriële omgevingen.
* 8% vakantiegeld.
* Bijdrage van 68% aan het pensioen.
* Eerst een jaarcontract, daarna uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

  

Daarnaast zijn er nog meer arbeidsvoorwaarden en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, die we graag in een persoonlijk gesprek verder toelichten. Samen verder praten over deze functie als Application engineer Industrial Automation. Reageer vandaag en krijg binnen 1 werkdag een terugkoppeling. Neem direct contact op met Nick Jansen via 06 \- 25 48 11 44\.


### **HIER GA JE WERKEN**


Je gaat aan de slag bij een gespecialiseerde industriële automatiseringspartij die procesbesturingen ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en implementeert voor productieomgevingen in onder andere de voedingsmiddelenindustrie, olie\- en gassector, chemie en farmacie. Vanuit het kantoor in Zeist worden zowel inhouse\-projecten gerealiseerd als opdrachten bij klanten in de BENELUX uitgevoerd. De organisatie richt zich op het automatiseren en optimaliseren van bedrijfsprocessen met slimme componenten en software, waarbij technieken als PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES en C\# worden ingezet voor moderne procesbesturingssystemen en digitalisering van productie.

  

Je werkt in een team met collega’s die een duidelijke passie voor techniek hebben en graag samen projecten realiseren. De sfeer is informeel en hands\-on, met korte lijnen en veel directe samenwerking tussen engineers en andere collega’s. In de praktijk betekent dit dat je regelmatig op locatie bij toonaangevende bedrijven staat om systemen te testen of in bedrijf te nemen, en op kantoor in Zeist samenwerkt aan ontwerp, ontwikkeling en simulatie. Er is veel aandacht voor kennisdeling, professionele ontwikkeling en het combineren van inhoudelijk uitdagend werk met een prettige werkomgeving, inclusief gezamenlijke activiteiten en uitjes.

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer hybrid job in Breda area
jobs.description:
**AI Software Engineer**


Breda, Netherlands (hybrid) · Senior, 7\+ years · Legal \& professional services


Epona365 is a cloud\-native platform built on Microsoft 365, used by legal and professional services firms across Europe. It integrates deeply with SharePoint, Exchange, Teams and Office, and runs asynchronous workers for OCR and metadata prediction, and semantic search.


We are looking for a senior engineer with strong AI knowledge. You will work across the full stack \- .NET services, Office add\-ins for Excel and Outlook, the web UI and Azure infrastructure \- with AI features as your focus. We use AI coding agents throughout the development cycle, from analyzing stories to writing code and resolving review comments: developers here direct outcomes rather than type code.


**What you will work on**


* Azure AI features \- filing and metadata suggestions, semantic search over firm documents, agentic workflows on Azure AI Agents.
* .NET microservices \- APIs, workers and processing pipelines.
* Office add\-ins and web UI \- TypeScript and the Office JavaScript API.
* Microsoft 365 integrations \- Graph SDK, SharePoint CSOM, Exchange Web Services.
* Azure infrastructure \- Container Apps, Bicep, Azure Pipelines, Docker.

You also help decide what we build: brainstorming new AI use cases with sales and consultants, prototyping quickly, and being honest about what is feasible today and what is not.


**Must haves**


* 7\+ years of professional development experience.
* Deep C\# and .NET \- services, APIs and asynchronous workers \- plus solid TypeScript.
* Experience shipping AI features in production: features real users depend on, not research or notebooks.
* Hands\-on with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry: prompt design, structured outputs, tool calling.
* Retrieval\-augmented generation: chunking and embedding documents, vector search, and grounding answers so they stay traceable to a source.
* Judgement about when not to use a language model, and awareness of cost, latency and prompt injection.
* Comfortable with AI coding agents: you can specify, review and correct machine\-written code.
* Able to explain to non\-technical colleagues, in plain language, what a model can and cannot do.

**Nice to haves**


* Semantic Kernel or Microsoft.Extensions.AI, and the Azure AI Agent Service.
* Azure AI Search (vector and hybrid) and Azure AI Document Intelligence.
* Model Context Protocol, or Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility.
* SharePoint development, or front\-end single\-page application experience.
* Legal tech, document management or another regulated sector.

You are analytical and proactive, communicate clearly, and enjoy working in an international, multidisciplinary team.

jobs.title: Professional Backend Developer
jobs.description:
**Wer Du bist**



Du hast 3\-5 Jahre Erfahrung im Java\-Stack und beherrschst Spring Boot souverän. Du entwickelst komplexe Features eigenständig von der Konzeption bis zum Release, denkst analytisch und trägst aktiv zu Architekturentscheidungen bei. **Du nutzt KI\-Assistenz (z.B. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) als etabliertes Produktivitätswerkzeug** – nicht nur zum Code\-Generieren, sondern auch für komplexe Refactorings, Architektur\-Diskussionen und Debugging – übernimmst aber die volle Verantwortung für Qualität, Security und Nachvollziehbarkeit der Lösungen. Du arbeitest selbstorganisiert, kommunizierst auf Augenhöhe mit Stakeholdern und unterstützt gern weniger erfahrene Entwickler beim Wachsen.


**Wer wir sind**



Plunet GmbH mit Standorten in Berlin, Würzburg und New York entwickelt und vertreibt die Business\- und Workflow\-Management\-Software „Plunet BusinessManager“ – eine der weltweit führenden Managementlösungen für die Übersetzungs\- und Lokalisierungsbranche. Unsere Kunden sind führende Übersetzungsagenturen, Regierungsorganisationen und NGOs sowie große internationale Industrie\- und Dienstleistungsunternehmen.


**Aufgaben**
------------


* **Entwicklung \& Architektur:** Du entwirfst und implementierst komplexe, skalierbare Backend\-Lösungen mit Spring Boot, inkl. Konfiguration von Security\-Mechanismen und Integration von Drittbibliotheken. Du hilfst mit, technische Lösungen in unserer Software\-Architektur zu gestalten.
* **Qualitätssicherung:** Du führst Code Reviews durch und stellst umfassende Testabdeckung mit JUnit, Mockito und SpringBootTest sicher – inkl. komplexer Integrationstests
* **Legacy \& Modernisierung:** Du refactorst bestehenden Code und modernisierst Kernkomponenten (Main Classes), ohne dabei die Systemstabilität zu gefährden.
* **Datenbanken:** Du optimierst Datenbankabfragen und \-designs (MySQL/MSSQL) und setzt Hibernate als ORM\-Werkzeug für komplexe Mapping\-Szenarien fortgeschritten ein.
* **Wissenstransfer:** Du bist aktives Mitglied in unseren Communities of Practice (CoPs), leitest diese bei Bedarf und mentorst Junior\-Entwickler bei Onboarding und fachlicher Entwicklung.
* **Integration:** Du integrierst den Plunet BusinessManager mit externen Systemen und arbeitest eng mit Product Specialists zusammen.
* **KI\-Integration:** Du nutzt KI\-Tools effektiv für Entwicklungstasks, validierst generierten Code kritisch hinsichtlich Clean Code, Security und Performance und hilfst mit, Best Practices für den KI\-Einsatz im Team zu etablieren.

**Qualifikation**
-----------------


* **Erfahrung:** 3\-5 Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung mit Schwerpunkt Backend/Java.
* **Java Advanced:** Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse von Design Patterns, Multithreading, Concurrency und aktuellen Java\-Versionen.
* **Spring Boot:** Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer, skalierbarer Anwendungen; sicherer Umgang mit Security\-Konfiguration und externer API\-Integration.
* **Softwaretests:** Advanced\-Level in Unit\- und Integrationstests mit JUnit, Mockito und SpringBootTest; Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierung.
* **Datenbanken:** Fortgeschrittene SQL\-Kenntnisse (MySQL, MSSQL), Query\-Optimierung und sicherer Umgang mit Hibernate.
* **Tooling:** Sicherer Umgang mit Git, CI/CD\-Pipelines und modernen IDEs (IntelliJ, VSCode).
* **KI\-Assistenz Professional:** Erfahrener Umgang mit KI\-Coding\-Assistenz für komplexe Entwicklungsszenarien; Fähigkeit zum effektiven Prompt Engineering; kritische Bewertung von KI\-Vorschlägen hinsichtlich Architektur\-Patterns, Security\-Risiken und Datenschutz; Bewusstsein für Limitationen und Halluzinationen.
* **Clean Code:** Du lebst Clean Code\-Prinzipien aktiv und hilfst anderen dabei, besser zu werden.
* **Soft Skills:** Starke analytische Fähigkeit zur Analyse komplexer Anforderungen und Entwurf effizienter Lösungen; hervorragende Selbstorganisation (Priorisierung, Zeitmanagement); exzellente Kommunikations\- und Teamfähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit mit Architekten und Stakeholdern; Bereitschaft, Junior\-Entwickler zu mentoren und Wissen weiterzugeben.
* **Sprachen:** Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (B2\+), Deutsch ist ein Plus.


**Nice\-to\-haves (Zusätzliche Aktivitäten \& Skills)**


* **Security:** Erfahrung mit der Analyse und Behebung von Sicherheitslücken in Dependencies (OWASP Dependency\-Check, Sicherheitsmanagement).
* **DevOps/Tooling:** Kenntnisse in Liquibase, SonarQube, GitLab Administration oder Docker.
* **Performance:** Erfahrung mit Performance\-Analyse (Thread\-Dumps, Heap\-Dumps) und Last\-tests.
* **Fullstack\-Perspektive:** Grundkenntnisse in Angular, TypeScript oder .NET.
* **Methodik:** Erfahrung mit agilen Frameworks (Scrum/Kanban) als aktiver Teamplayer.
* **Schulung:** Du erstellst Präsentationen und Schulungen für andere Entwickler, um spezifisches Wissen zu verbreiten.

**Benefits**
------------


**Flexible Arbeitszeiten \& Work\-Life\-Balance**  

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und faire Überstundenregelungen sorgen für eine gesunde Balance zwischen Berufs\- und Privatleben.


**Eigenverantwortung \& agile Unternehmenskultur**  

Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung in einem transparenten und agilen Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien.


**Teamgeist \& Zusammenarbeit**  

Eine offene, respektvolle Unternehmenskultur, in der Teamarbeit großgeschrieben wird.


**Exklusive Benefits \& Zusatzleistungen**  

Du profitierst von Hrmony (digitalen Essenszuschüssen), einem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und unserer Kooperation mit JobRad für eine komfortable Mobilität.


**Interesse geweckt? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!**


**Diversity \& Inclusion**  

Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit, Fairness und gegenseitigen Respekt ein und ermutigen Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, sich zu bewerben.


**Anonymer Bewerbungsprozess**  

Du kannst dich gerne ohne Foto und ohne persönliche Angaben bewerben. Geschlecht, Alter, Name, Familienstand oder Herkunft sind für uns nicht entscheidend.



Überzeuge uns mit deinen Qualifikationen, deinen Fähigkeiten und deiner Motivation, Teil von Plunet zu werden.


**Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!**

jobs.title: Software Developer C++ (3D Graphics) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
* Munich (DE)
* Wuppertal (DE)
* Wurzburg (DE)
* Software Development
* Fulltime
* Published: 2026\-07\-07
**What do we do?**
------------------


**Introducing Thinkproject Platform**


Thinkproject is a European leader in the digitalization of the construction industry, with
  

offices and customers spanning Europe and beyond.


Founded in 2000 — when construction project planning was still predominantly manual — Thinkproject was built on deep industry expertise and a mission to make complex
  

construction projects manageable. Today, we call it Construction Intelligence: software
  

that makes construction projects more efficient, safer, more punctual, and above
  

all, more sustainable.


**VDC Manager** is one of the flagship products in our portfolio — a complete openBIM
  

platform at the intersection of 3D modeling, process management, and data
  

intelligence.


**What your day will look like**
--------------------------------


**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a C\+\+ Software Developer to join the team behind VDC
  

Manager — Thinkproject's complete openBIM software, developed by industry experts
  

and trusted by AEC professionals worldwide.


VDC Manager enables the merging of diverse data and information into BIM processes,
  

including model checking and clash detection in 3D models, construction schedule
  

creation and 4D simulation, quantity and dimension determination for cost calculations, and much more. As a member of the engineering team, you will take ownership of complex features, drive technical decisions, and help shape the future of one of Europe's leading BIM platforms.


**What You Will Do**
  

**Core Development**


* Architect, design, develop, and test new and existing features within VDC Manager
* Write clean, well\-structured, secure, and testable modern C\+\+ code (C\+\+17/20\)
* Take ownership of complex technical areas — from geometry processing and 3D rendering to data exchange and cloud connectivity
* Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability
* Drive technical analysis and research, including evaluation and selection of technical approaches and third\-party components

**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, UX designers, and BIM domain experts to translate requirements into robust technical solutions
* Demonstrate and present technical work to product owners and stakeholders in a clear and structured manner
* Work as part of a distributed, international team — contributing to technical discussions on implementation approaches and user interfaces
* Continuously learn and apply modern tools, frameworks, and engineering processes
**What you need to fulfill the role**
-------------------------------------


**Must\-Have**


* Knowledge of C/C\+\+, including modern standards (C\+\+14/17/20\).
* Hands\-on experience with graphics programming (OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan, or similar)
* Strong skills in software architecture, data structures, and design patterns
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills — able to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, software quality practices (performance, scalability, security, testability)
* Fluency in English (written and spoken) — our working language across the engineering team

**Strong Advantages**

Seit 2010 unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Prozesse effizienter, transparenter und erfolgreicher zu gestalten.**


### **Unser Team vereint Fachwissen aus** **Ernährung, Software Engineering, Prozessmanagement und Finanzbuchhaltung****. Diese Kombination aus fachlichem Verständnis und technischer Umsetzungskompetenz macht uns zu einem Partner, der komplexe Anforderungen wirklich versteht und zuverlässig umsetzt.**


### **Wir denken nicht in Einzellösungen, sondern im** **Gesamtsystem****.** **Unser 360°‑Ansatz** **verbindet Datenbeschaffung, Systemintegration und laufenden Betrieb zu einem durchgängigen Leistungsangebot. Aus einer Hand, mit festen Ansprechpartnern und auf Augenhöhe.**


### **Mit best 4 bps gewinnen Sie einen Partner, der** **mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt** **und auch anspruchsvolle Projekte** **stabil und verlässlich** **realisiert.**


  
Data Engineer / Application Integration Manager (m/w/d)
##### **Du möchtest Daten nicht nur verwalten, sondern daraus zuverlässige, intelligente Lösungen entwickeln?**


### **Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.**


### **Wir sind** **best4bps** **– ein Team aus über 30 Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten für Datenmanagement, Systemintegration, Softwareentwicklung und digitale Prozesslösungen.**


### **Seit 2010 unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, komplexe IT\-Landschaften, Datenflüsse und Geschäftsprozesse zuverlässig, sicher und zukunftsfähig zu gestalten. Dabei verbinden wir moderne Microsoft\-Technologien, individuelle Softwarelösungen und innovative Datenplattformen zu einem leistungsfähigen Gesamtsystem.**


### **Für unser Team suchen wir einen Menschen, der Datenflüsse, Anwendungen und Integrationen ganzheitlich**
**denkt. Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, technische und fachliche Anforderungen sicher bewertet und Freude daran hat, Datenarchitekturen und digitale Lösungen aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.**


##### **Deine Aufgaben**


* ### **Entwicklung und Durchführung von Projekten im Datenmanagement, in der Datenanalyse und**
* ### **Datenvisualisierung sowie Umsetzung von Entwicklungs\- und Customizingaufgaben mit Lobster Data und Lobster Pro, einschließlich SQL\-Entwicklung und Betreuung interner Datenbanken**
* ### **Entwicklung und Customizing von Komponenten unserer unternehmensrelevanten Softwareprodukte sowie aktive Mitwirkung in allen Phasen des Entwicklungsprozesses**
* ### **Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb unserer Datenarchitektur, insbesondere zur Umsetzung von Anforderungen aus dem operativen Geschäft**
* ### **Weiterentwicklung und Betreuung bestehender Anwendungen auf Basis der EDI\-Middleware Lobster, insbesondere in den Bereichen Integration und Orchestration**
* ### **Konzeption, Entwicklung und Implementierung von Datenverarbeitungsprozessen zur Extraktion, Transformation und Aufbereitung strukturierter, unstrukturierter und qualitativer Daten mit unterschiedlichen Technologien**
* ### **Erstellung, Optimierung und Pflege der im Rahmen der Tätigkeit erforderlichen SQL\-Statements**
* ### **Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenverfügbarkeit und kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer hohen Datenqualität**
* ### **Eigenständige Bewertung von Daten und Prozessen, eigenverantwortliche Klärung von Unstimmigkeiten sowie Überwachung eingeleiteter Verbesserungsmaßnahmen**
* ### **Aktive Unterstützung beim weiteren Aufbau unserer IT\-Prozesse sowie bei der Etablierung des internen Qualitätsmanagements im Datenmanagement**
* ### **Identifikation, Integration und Umsetzung geeigneter KI\- und Machine\-Learning\-Lösungen sowie Entwicklung,**
* ### **Betreuung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von ML\-Modellen in bestehenden und neuen Projekten**
* ### **Aktive Teilnahme an regelmäßigen Entwickler\-Meetings: Du diskutierst fachliche Themen mit Deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, bringst Dein Wissen ein und erweiterst kontinuierlich Deine Kenntnisse**

##### **Was Dich bei uns erwartet**


### **Bei uns arbeitest Du nicht isoliert an einzelnen Datenpipelines oder Schnittstellen.**


### **Du entwickelst und betreibst unsere Datenarchitektur, realisierst Integrations\- und Customizinglösungen mit Lobster Data und Lobster Pro und bringst Deine Erfahrung in Datenmanagement\-, Analyse\-, Visualisierungs sowie KI\- und Machine\-Learning\-Projekte ein.**


### **Kurz gesagt: Du sorgst dafür, dass Daten zuverlässig fließen, Anwendungen intelligent zusammenspielen**
**und aus Anforderungen tragfähige technische Lösungen entstehen.**


##### **Was uns besonders macht**


### **Bei uns arbeitest Du nicht im Datensilo**


### **Datenmanagement, Softwareentwicklung, Integration und operative Prozesse gehören für uns zusammen. Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend und erhältst Einblicke in die gesamte technische Wertschöpfungskette.**
**Dadurch kannst Du Lösungen von der fachlichen Anforderung über Datenmodell, Schnittstelle und**
**Verarbeitung bis zum produktiven Betrieb mitgestalten und deine Kenntnisse kontinuierlich ausbauen.**


### **Deine Ideen sind gefragt**


### **Wir schätzen Menschen, die mitdenken und eigene Vorschläge einbringen.**
**Wenn Du Verbesserungspotenzial erkennst, hören wir zu.**
**Wenn Du eine gute Idee hast, setzen wir sie gemeinsam um.**


### **KI und Machine Learning sind für uns Zukunft und Gegenwart**

### **Wir entwickeln und integrieren bereits heute KI\-gestützte Lösungen für unsere Kunden und unsere eigenen**
**Produkte. Du erhältst die Möglichkeit, Machine\-Learning\-Modelle und neue Technologien praxisnah**
**einzusetzen, weiterzuentwickeln und in bestehende Daten\- und Anwendungslandschaften zu integrieren.**


### **Kommunikation ist uns wichtig**

### **Technisches Know\-how allein reicht nicht aus. Wir legen großen Wert auf eine offene, direkte und respektvolle Zusammenarbeit.**


### **Da Du täglich mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, Kunden und externen Partnern kommunizierst, sind sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1\) in Wort und Schrift für diese Position unverzichtbar.**


### **Wir suchen Teamplayer, die technische Sachverhalte verständlich erklären können und Freude daran haben, gemeinsam Lösungen zu erarbeiten.**


##### **Das bringst Du idealerweise mit**


* ### **Abgeschlossene IT\-Ausbildung, ein Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation**
* ### **Praktische Erfahrung im Data Engineering, Application Management, in der Softwareentwicklung oder in der Integration datenführender Anwendungen**
* ### **Sehr gute SQL\-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und der Optimierung von Abfragen**
* ### **Erfahrung mit ETL\-/ELT\-Prozessen, Datenpipelines sowie der Verarbeitung (un\-)strukturierter Daten**
* ### **Gutes Verständnis von Schnittstellen, APIs, Integrationsarchitekturen und orchestrierten Datenflüssen**
* ### **Kenntnisse in mindestens einer geeigneten Skript\- oder Programmiersprache, idealerweise Python, C\#, .NET oder vergleichbaren Technologien**
* ### **Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit Datenqualität, Fehleranalyse und produktiven Datenprozessen**
* ### **Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen zu verstehen, technisch zu bewerten und in tragfähige Lösungen zu überführen**
* ### **Selbstständige, strukturierte und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise**
* ### **Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit im Austausch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, Kunden und externen Partnern**

### **Wünschenswert, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung**


* ### **Erfahrung mit Lobster Data, Lobster Pro oder einer vergleichbaren Integrations\- bzw. EDI\-Plattform**
* ### **Erfahrung mit REST\-APIs, EDI, Orchestration oder vergleichbaren Integrationsverfahren**
* ### **Kenntnisse in Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence oder Datenvisualisierung, zum Beispiel mit Tableau oder vergleichbaren Lösungen**
* ### **Erste praktische Erfahrung mit KI\- und Machine\-Learning\-Verfahren sowie dem Lebenszyklus von ML\-Modellen**
* ### **Kenntnisse im Qualitätsmanagement, in Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit oder der nachvollziehbaren Dokumentation von Datenprozessen**
* ### **Interesse an Automatisierung, Cloud\-Technologien, Datenplattformen und KI\-gestützten Prozesslösungen**

### **Wichtig sind uns fundierte technische Grundlagen, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Lernbereitschaft und die**
**Fähigkeit, operative Daten\- und Integrationsthemen ebenso zuverlässig zu übernehmen wie längerfristige**
**Entwicklungsprojekte.**


##### **Deine Benefits**


* ### **Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gestaltungsspielraum**
* ### **Hybrides Arbeiten und Homeoffice\-Möglichkeiten**
* ### **Betriebliche Altersversorgung und betriebliche Krankenversicherung (Zusatz)**
* ### **Moderne Hardware und zeitgemäße Arbeitsmittel**
* ### **Spannende Projekte rund um Datenarchitekturen, Integration, EDI, KI und moderne Softwaretechnologien**
* ### **Mitarbeit an innovativen KI\- und Digitalisierungsprojekten**
* ### **Individuelle Weiterbildungs\- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten**
* ### **Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Eigenverantwortung**
* ### **Kollegiales Team mit offener Unternehmenskultur**
* ### **Langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Technologieunternehmen**
* ### **Die Möglichkeit, Infrastruktur, Anwendungen und Sicherheitsprozesse aktiv mitzugestalten**

##### **Warum best4bps?**


### **Weil Du bei uns nicht nur Systeme verwaltest.**


### **Du entwickelst Lösungen, optimierst Prozesse, arbeitest mit modernen Cloud\- und KI\-Technologien und gestaltest die digitale Zukunft unseres Unternehmens aktiv mit.**


### **Wenn Du einen Arbeitsplatz suchst, an dem Deine Ideen zählen, Deine Arbeit sichtbar wird und Technik wirklich spannend bleibt, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung.**

### **Werde Teil von best4bps, gestalte mit uns die nächste Generation digitaler Lösungen und schreibe deine Bewerbung mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung an:**


### **best 4 bps GmbH \& Co. KG**


### **Reinhard Meyer**


### **Bahnstraße 18**


### **40699 Erkrath**


### **karriere@best4bps.de**

### **Wir freuen uns schon, Dich kennenzulernen.**


  
**Unsere Werte:**
-----------------


* Respekt.
* Verantwortung.
* Stabilität.
* Partnerschaft.

##### **Respekt**


### **Wir begegnen Kunden, Partnern und Kollegen auf Augenhöhe: offen, ehrlich und wertschätzend.**


##### **Verantwortung**

### **Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für unsere Lösungen, unsere Arbeit und den Erfolg unserer Kunden.**


##### **Stabilität**

**Location**
------------


Birmingham, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Exeter, Ipswich, Leeds, Manchester, Newcastle and Nottingham. (Croydon and Stratford will only be available to existing employees of the Insolvency Service).**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**


We have an exciting opportunity for a talented, enthusiastic Technical Architect within the Insolvency Service Digital Services team working on a programme of work to maintain, improve and modernise our line\-of\-business applications.


The Insolvency Service is a leading government agency which plays a crucial role in providing essential services to the public and to business. The work we do is important to the proper functioning of markets, the economy in general and support for thousands of people each year who are in financial difficulty.


Inclusive and diverse teams are important to us. We welcome and encourage applications from everyone, including groups underrepresented in our workforce. The Insolvency Service strives to ensure that the agency is a safe, inclusive, and welcoming place for everybody to bring their true self to work and to help the agency to achieve its diversity objectives. We have 9 active employee network groups available to join or become an ally, these include, Carers Network, Disability network group, Employee Assistance, Representatives, FACES Network Group, LGBT\+, Mind Matters, Part Time Workers, The Shed \- Mens Network Group and Womens Network Group.


We value capability, technical skills and experience and we place great emphasis on lifetime development to support our people. We encourage our employees to become more involved in areas they feel strongly about, whether it be for the benefit of the agency, through our Engagement network or in their own local communities via volunteering opportunities.


The Insolvency Service is a great place to work, learn and grow your career!


If you would like to find out more about the role, the team and what it's like to work at the Insolvency Service, we are holding a Hiring Manager Q\&A session for this role where you can virtually meet the team on 5th October at 10:30 \- 11:30\. Please click here to reserve your place.

### **Job description**


The successful candidate will be working on the Digital Service team (part of the Change Technology Services within the Insolvency Service) responsible for Digital applications used by internal and external organisations as well as the general public.


The role ensures that solutions are aligned to business objectives, user needs, government standards and long\-term strategic goals. They provide architectural expertise across products, platforms and delivery teams, balancing immediate delivery needs with the sustainable evolution of the estate.


Working with the Principal Technical Architect across Digital Services and the wider Insolvency Service, the Technical Architect establishes technical standards, architectural principles and governance processes that enable teams to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable and resilient services.

**Responsibilities**


Architecture:

* define target architectures and future technology direction
* develop and maintain architectural roadmaps
* produce and maintain reference architectures and design patterns
* participate in architecture reviews and governance activities
* support delivery teams in applying architecture principles
* provide guidance on complex technical decisions


Technical Governance:

* support technical assurance forums
* review significant technical decisions
* ensure solutions comply with security, accessibility and operational standards
* assess architectural impacts of proposed change
* identify and manage technical and architectural risks
* maintain architecture decision records and governance artefacts


Platform and Strategic Direction:

* drive adoption of shared platforms, reusable services and common capabilities
* help the evolution of Digital Services platforms
* support service consolidation and technology rationalisation initiatives


Engineering and Delivery Support:

* work closely with Lead Developers to maintain engineering standards
* support teams facing complex technical challenges
* review solution designs and implementation approaches
* ensure delivery teams understand architectural expectations
* help balance technical quality, delivery speed and operational sustainability


Stakeholder Engagement:

* engage with senior business and technical stakeholders on strategic technology matters
* translate complex technical concepts into language understood by business audiences
* represent Digital Services in cross\-government, assurance and governance forums
* influence organisational decision\-making through evidence\-based technical advice


Capability Development:

* develop architectural capability across Digital Services
* promote Communities of Practice and knowledge sharing
* establish standards, guidance and architectural artefacts
### **Person specification**

* communication skills. You can listen to the needs of technical and business stakeholders and interpret them. You are skilled at proactive and reactive communication
* governance. You can evolve and define governance. You can take responsibility for collaborating and supporting other staff in wider governance. You know how to assure services delivered by technical architects across sets of services
* making and guiding decisions. You can make decisions characterised by managed levels of risk and complexity. You can recommend decisions as risk and complexity increase. You can resolve technical disputes between wider peers and indirect stakeholders, taking into account all views and opinions
* strategy. You can apply strategy, using patterns, standards, policies, roadmaps and vision statements. You can challenge them and provide guidance
* turning business problems into technical design. You can design systems characterised by medium levels of risk, impact, and business or technical complexity. You can work across multiple services or a single large or complicated service
* understanding the whole context. You understand trends and practices outside your team and how these will impact the work. You understand how your work fits into the broader strategy and historical context. You can consider the patterns and interactions on a larger scale
* you should ideally come from a software development background, preferably .NET/C\#
* you should have experience in cloud transformations ideally using Azure
* you should have experience is a number of differing technologies
* it would be preferable for candidates to have GDS Service Manual, Government architecture/design experience
### **Behaviours**


We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:


* Seeing the Big Picture
* Communicating and Influencing
### **Technical skills**


We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:


* During the interview you will be given a hypothetical scenario that will assess your technical knowledge and approach. You are not required to create a presentation.
**Benefits**
------------


Alongside your salary of £57,367, Insolvency Service contributes £16,619 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .
We want you to have a good work\-life balance and want to support you in all that you do, so we offer a great benefits package including:


* flexible working arrangements and flexi\-time
* full time new entrants to the Civil Service and those Civil Servants on modernised terms and conditions will be entitled to 25 days leave increasing on a sliding scale to 30 days after 5 years service
* in addition to this you are entitled to 8 public/bank holidays plus an additional day of privilege leave
* competitive maternity, paternity and parental leave
* 5 days paid leave for learning and development
* 5 days paid for volunteering
* a Cycle to work scheme
* staff have access to an employee assistance programme, Workplace Wellness, for confidential, independent support and advice during difficult times in either their professional or personal life


Your pension is a valuable part of your total reward package where the employer makes a significant contribution to the cost of your pension. Your contributions come out of your salary before any tax is taken. This means, if you pay tax, your take\-home pay will not be reduced by the full amount of your contribution; and your pension will continue to provide valuable benefits for you and your family if you are too ill to continue to work or die before you retire. For more information, visit www.civilservicepensionscheme.org.uk


**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.### **Selection process details**


This vacancy is using Success Profiles , and will assess your Behaviours, Experience and Technical skills.
As part of the sift process, you will be asked to complete:

**CV**

**Multi\-Stage Screening Process**


As part of the application process, candidates will be asked to upload a CV outlining their experience, skills and suitability for the role, and complete a multi\-stage screening process. Candidates who are longlisted will be invited to complete a 5 minute, pre\-recorded video screening interview. Alternatively, a 750 word written response may be provided in place of the video interview. Our recruitment partner (Inspire People) will assess applications against the essential criteria to produce a shortlist, which will then be reviewed by Insolvency Service hiring managers. Successful candidates will be invited to interview.


If successful at the sift stage, at interview, you will be assessed on the following:

* Behaviour 1 \- Seeing the Big Picture
* Behaviour 2 \- Communicating and Influencing

**Technical Skills**

**Queries and Support**

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.### **Security**

The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria.### **Diversity and Inclusion**


The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy .**Apply and further information**

### **Job description**


The Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) deliver wide reaching digital services to the UK public and industry. We maintain the national record of vehicles and drivers. If you have applied for a driving licence, changed vehicle, re\-licensed your vehicle or completed a vehicle enquiry you would have used one of our services.


The time is right to join one of the leading agile, cloud and technical departments in the government, one that is constantly pushing the boundaries of technological innovation to find, develop, and introduce new and innovative technological advancements. On a modern cloud platform, we work with a range of industry\-leading technologies, such as serverless, Docker, and Kubernetes.


If you are successful, you will be part of the new electronic Vehicle Excise Duty programme which is a new legislative, digital service being delivered by DVLA to modernise how Vehicle Excise Duty is administered and delivered digitally. This is an exciting time to join us!


Within and between our teams, we have a friendly and stable engineering community. Keeping work life enjoyable is key to us, and we strive to ensure the efficient and secure use of software and infrastructure.  

  

Our current deliveries include:

* Two major programmes of work, modernising our drivers and vehicles services and systems.
* Entirely new services including a new customer portal, mobile digital driving licence and identity platform.
* The DVLA digital payment service that helps us collect around 6 billion pounds a year.
* New versions of key driving licence services that will help us to reduce paper forms, reduce waiting times and to enable all of our customers to transact digitally.


As part of our core business services, you will work with Java and SpringBoot alongside tools like OpenAPI. No specific Java experience is needed. All you need is a passion for building clean, maintainable, and secure applications using an object\-oriented language.


If youre working on the front\-end, youll be developing applications and reusable components using a combination of Ruby on Rails and React. You will also have the opportunity to build and develop our external and internal UIs, so this is an exciting opportunity to deliver far reaching, intuitive and accessible front\-end systems.


As part of our ongoing mission to support and develop all staff within the DVLA, you will be given a high spec Macbook and we will help you to achieve certification in areas such as AWS and Java, as well as giving you the freedom and support necessary to perform in your role and continuously develop your skill set.


DVLA have been using AI coding assistants for over two years and actively encourage and support the appropriate use of AI coding tools. We have an AI coding group and are working together to understand how to use AI coding assistants responsibly to build better digital services.


Your responsibilities will include, but arent limited to:

* Working within a technical framework of the project to meet customer requirements.
* Developing Software in an agile team environment.
* Application Support.
* Working closely with business analysts and agile delivery managers to prepare and review user stories and tasks.
* Some testing responsibilities.
* Mentoring junior developers within the team.


Great line management is important to us as an organisation, and we will equip and support line managers to develop the skills they need. We aim to empower line managers to create teams where people can flourish and deliver excellent outcomes for the public.


For further information on the role, please read the attached role profile. Please note that the role profile is for information purposes only \- whilst all elements are relevant to the role, they may not all be assessed during the recruitment process. This job advert will detail exactly what will be assessed during the recruitment process.

### **Person specification**


Required experience:


To be successful in this role you will need to have the following experience:

* Working as a software engineer across multiple teams and projects, developing software using a variety of modern technologies and tools.
* A passion for back\-end, front\-end development, security or serverless technology.
* You will need to be comfortable in using modern CI/CD tooling with an understanding of languages such as Java, Ruby, C\#, HTML, Python or similar. As we develop, we are committed to the development of our employees, so we will help you achieve certification in these areas as well as AWS and Azure.
* You need to have a passion for modern software development technologies and standard methodologies.
* You would need to have had to communicate with engineering peers and business partners.

**Additional Information**


The role is part of the Government Digital and Data profession and utilises an enhanced CapabilityBased Pay Framework which provides access to a Digital and Data allowance.


The base pay is £44,241\. In addition to this the role includes a Digital and Data allowance of up to £14,756\.


The value of allowance awarded will be based on an assessment of your skills and experience as demonstrated through the selection process. Here are more details on the pay framework.

**Working for the DVLA Digital Team**

### **Technical skills**

Passionate, reliable and always willing to push yourself and those around you, youll continue to seek improvement in your own role and challenge us too. Because we pride ourselves on how we approach your development. From training courses to specialist skills workshops and opportunities to grow your expertise, we thrive when you thrive. Stage 1: Sift of CV \& Personal statement


Stage 2: Interview

* Hate speech or discriminatory behaviour
* Threats or acts of violence

jobs.description:
Programme
Full Time Graduate
Career Path
Technology
Location
London
Start Date
September\-2027
### **Programme Description**


**What does this team do?**


Our Tax Consulting practice provides companies and high net worth individuals with advice on their tax, ensuring they remain compliant with regulations. From advising clients on investment tax to working with their innovation and property teams to ensure that the available tax reliefs are maximised, we help our clients make the right business decisions, on a worldwide scale.


A Tax Technology \& Engineering role, could mean the opportunity to work within one of the following teams:


**Digital Innovation – Digital Tax Solutions:** We are a pioneering team, committed to building cutting\-edge digital tax products and solutions. Leveraging an AI\-first approach to development, we discover, design, and deliver market\-leading innovation. We continuously experiment with new technologies to transform our business and drive revenue growth.


**Global Investments \& Innovation Incentives (Gi3\)**: The UK government offers generous tax incentives to companies operating across all areas of science, engineering and tech, to encourage investment in research and development. The Gi3 team is part of a global network of tech, engineering, science and financial specialists who work closely with companies of varying size (from start\-ups to large multinationals), helping them unlock these incentives for their innovations in chemicals, pharmaceuticals, oil and gas, manufacturing etc. This involves working closely with our clients to identify their eligible projects (and attributable expenditure), maximising the valuable incentives available.


Our team comprises specialists from both tax/financial and tech backgrounds, where engineers, scientists and IT/software technologists play a pivotal role in supporting our clients in unlocking the incentives available to them. We partner with clients working on some of the most exciting and innovative projects across all areas of science and technology.


**What skills and academic qualifications do I need?**


**Digital Innovation – Digital Tax Solutions**


We require you to demonstrate an interest in, or a degree related to, developing products, Computer Science or Software Engineering.


Related degree disciplines include:


* Computer games and animation.
* Information Systems.
* Computing.
* Engineering and technology.
* Cyber Security.

**Global Investment \& Innovation Incentives – Software Engineering:**


We require you to hold, or be working towards, a degree within a Computer Science, Software


Development/Software Engineering or related discipline.


Related degree disciplines include:


* Data Science.
* Mathematics.
* Electrical Engineering.
* Cyber Security.

**Global Investment \& Innovation Incentives – Engineering** (STEM)


We require you to have achieved, or be working towards, a degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics related degree discipline.


You’ll need to have obtained or be studying towards a minimum 2:1 degree as mentioned above and have graduated by September 2027 for the Autumn 2027 intake.


We have identified 10 core skills that are essential to all our roles in Early Careers. To learn more about these skills and their detailed descriptions, please visit the 'Discover What We Look For' section in our Candidate Zone.


**What kind of work will I do?**


By joining a student programme within Tax Technology \& Engineering, you will work with and learn from some of the most talented and experienced professionals in the industry.


You’ll have the opportunity to work with a range of clients, from FTSE 100 organisations to start\-ups and private individuals.


You’ll help them solve some of the most complex issues their business is ever likely to face. Many of our established clients are high profile, household names. You will play a key role in a multi\-disciplinary collaborative team and will learn about the UK's latest tech developments.


Depending on the area you join, you may be using your technical background to understand and support a client’s development activities or form the basis for their research and development, patent box claims and grant applications. Alternatively, by using cloud services and cutting\-edge technology (then applying it to the tax technology domain) you will support the build of software platforms to provide better business insight and efficiencies.


**Where will I work?**


At Deloitte we recognise how important face\-to\-face interaction is for your development in a new role. We also understand that our people need flexibility, which is why we operate a hybrid system, with a combination of office and home working. If you’re in a client\-facing role, you might be expected to attend client sites on certain days, while your meetings will be a mix of online and in\-person events. Please note your final assessment and induction will also be in\-person, to give you the opportunity to network and build relationships.


**All our workspaces are accessible, however, if you require further flexibility due to a health condition or caring responsibilities, please discuss this with our team. You can find further information on our** **parent and carer policies here.**


**How will I develop?**


We want our people to have worldclass practical experience coupled with the technical rigour and knowledge that comes from the right professional qualification.


We think the best experience is being immersed in client work, working alongside other team members, and learning the practical skills that will set you up for a successful career. That will be the initial focus whether you are a Graduate, an Industrial Placement, or a BrightStart, supported by internal training and support from coaches, people leaders, and your team.


We think this is vital and will set you up for success when we further support your development with a professional qualification, recognising that different roles across our business align to different pathways. These may include options such as joint or accelerated programmes leading to qualifications like Association of Taxation Technicians (ATT), Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA), Institute of Chartered Accountants of Scotland (ICAS) or Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA), as well as other more specialist routes focused on tax or technical expertise.


**Additional support and benefits information**


* We’re a collaborative, inclusive firm and we want to help you to use your unique talents and perspectives in the workplace. From diversity networks to wellbeing and much more, we aim to support and reward you in the best way possible. Please use the links below to discover more about our processes, benefits, values and culture.
* You can learn more about the full recruitment process here.
* Do you have accessibility requirements or need reasonable adjustments for the interview or assessment process? Find out how we can help.
* Learn more about our values, culture and purpose as a firm.
* Want to hear from some of our people to inspire your future career? Check out our Life at Deloitte page.
* At Deloitte we value diversity, and we’re committed to ensuring that our people thrive through a wide range of initiatives and diversity networks. Discover more about inclusion and wellbeing.
* We value our people and recognise their hard work. Learn about the rewards and benefits available at Deloitte.

**Application deadlines**


**Application deadlines:** There is no specific deadline for this role, but we recommend getting your application in as soon as possible. Please note, some of our roles may close quickly if we experience high demand.


**Assessment deadlines:** Once you’ve applied to this role, you’ll receive an email from our recruitment team outlining next steps and the relevant deadlines for you to complete the following stages of our process.


We operate a strict one application per year policy across our Early Careers opportunities. We recommend only submitting an application for a role that you feel is right for you.


**Visa Sponsorship**


We accept applications from candidates who are currently on student visas for this role. We cannot accept applications from candidates who have previously spent time on a Skilled Worker or Graduate visa. If successful to offer, you must stay on your student visa until our immigration team contacts you c.3 months before your start date. See our Work Permits page for more information.


**What matters to you? Make it happen at Deloitte.**

* Computing.

* Cyber Security.

* Mathematics.
* Electrical Engineering.
* Cyber Security.

jobs.description:
**United Kingdom, Aberdeen**
----------------------------

Apply Now **Job Title**
**Field Engineer Trainee (****Completions \& Well Intervention)**  

**About Us**
We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. At SLB we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. We are facing the world’s greatest balancing act\- how to simultaneously reduce emissions and meet the world’s growing energy demands. Our collective future depends on decarbonizing the fossil fuel industry, while innovating a new energy landscape. It’s what drives us. Ensuring progress for people and the planet, on the journey to net zero and beyond.  

More than 98,000 employees over 120 countries already started their SLB journeys. Start yours now!  

Aberdeen  

**Job Summary**
Field Engineer Trainees play a crucial role in our company’s growth by developing into future technical specialists, managers and leaders. This position provides the opportunity to build expertise in product knowledge, leadership, customer interaction and the delivery of engineering services accurately, safely and efficiently. As a Field Engineer Trainee, you will have opportunities to work towards professional membership with a relevant engineering institution. You will learn the business from the ground up, gaining the knowledge, skills and experience needed to become a skilled and confident specialist in your field.  

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing area of the business, supporting **Completions \& Well Intervention (CWI)** activities. You will join a small, collaborative team and undertake a structured training programme designed to develop your technical knowledge, field experience, customer\-facing skills and engineering capabilities. As you progress through your development and achieve the required technical competencies, you will have the opportunity to progress into a specialised CWI Engineering role, providing engineering and operational support for completion and well intervention activities.  

**Essential Responsibilities and Duties**
During the training program, your responsibilities will include:
* Ensure job deliverables are accurate and delivered on time.
* Supporting the planning and execution of completion, workover and well intervention operations.
* Supporting the preparation and review of Authorisations for Expenditure (AFEs)
* Develop an understanding of well integrity, well barriers, pressure control and applicable safety and regulatory requirements.
* Execute service delivery to the customer.
* Participate in job risk analysis and continual improvement programs.
* Develop customer contacts to promote company products and services.
* Ensure company and regulatory standard compliance by implementing the Compliance Assessment Tool (CAT), self\-assessments, and well site inspections.
* Participate in HSE and Quality initiatives.
* Wear PPE and observe HSE policies.
* Maintain the required safety training.
  

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Engineering. Candidates with degrees in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Petroleum, Process Engineering are particularly encouraged to apply.
* Be globally mobile.
* Willingness and ability to work in a field\-based and operational environment.
* The desire to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic business on high\-value, technically complex products/projects.
* The right to work in the United Kingdom.
  

**Preferred Skills**
* Strong interpersonal skills to communicate clearly and confidently.
* Be able to choose and initiate action.
* Be passionate about learning and research.
* Be eager to deliver results and meet demands.
* Remain positive during pressures, setbacks, and fast\-paced environments.
  

If this role is of interest to you and you are eager to learn more then we strongly encourage you to apply. We can then discuss how you will help shape and grow SLB moving forward  

**Why, as a graduate, should you join us**
* **Dynamic work environments**

The strength of our culture means you’ll work in a fast\-paced, supportive work environment. We offer hybrid working with a combination of on\-site \& home working days to achieve the right work\-life balance and allotted time for participating in volunteering and sustainability efforts.
* **Developing future leaders**

Become part of a community where your potential to lead is nurtured from the start. Joining us opens doors to leadership opportunities within our organization and across the broader industry, as evidenced by over 90% of our executive team who began their careers with us.
* **Borderless careers**

Our career\-building approach means you’ll have dedicated systems and an open, honest dialogue with managers and HR, helping you develop your career with potential opportunities across regions, functions and businesses.
* **Women in STEM**

Diversity is a key part of our success, and we have focused on gender balance for nearly 25 years. We are dedicated to nurturing and developing female talent both locally and globally. To support this goal, SLB has several initiatives, including mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company\-wide webinars, all aimed at helping women succeed.
* **Industry\-Leading Equipment**

Engage with cutting\-edge technology positioned at the forefront of the industry, contributing to pioneering advancements.  

**Benefits:**
* Competitive salary.
* We offer private healthcare for employees and their families as well as subsidised dental care.
* We provide well\-being programs such as Employee Mental health support and health and wellness coaching.
* Generous private employee\-funded pension contributions.
* Income protection scheme and life insurance.
* Cycle to work scheme.
* We have multiple internal employee resources groups, female mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company\-wide webinars, amongst other opportunities.

Other benefits are also available through the SLB flexible benefits program.  

**Flexible working**
We are open to flexible, hybrid working with a combination of on\-site \& home working days.  

**Certifications and Awards**
* We are proudly recognized as a disability\-confident, committed level employer.
* The Disability Equality Index awarded us the title of "Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion" in 2023\.
* Ranked among LinkedIn's "top companies in the UK for career development" for 2024\.
* Proud members of Business Disability Inn and the Valuable 500 initiative.
* Proudly ranked 4\.3 out of 5 on Glassdoor for Equality, Diversity and Inclusion.
* Proudly ranked 4\.1 out of 5 on Glassdoor for overall employee benefits.
* Proudly ranked 4\.2 out of 5 overall on Indeed.
  

**Still want to know more about SLB?**
Why not follow some of these useful links below to learn more about us directly from some of our employees?
* **Our People \- hear our stories**
* **Our Stories \- women in STEM**
  

*SLB is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or other characteristics protected by law. \#SLB*
 **Benefits**
------------

### **International Opportunities**


Global adventure, broad exposure, and limitless learning await you. You'll be part of the most multi\-cultural and diverse team of experts in any industry, anywhere.


### **Insurance**


Health, vision, and dental insurance for you and your dependents available from day one.


### **Learning Opportunities**


Global adventure, broad exposure, and limitless learning await you. You'll be part of the most multi\-cultural and diverse team of experts in any industry, anywhere.


### **Diverse and Inclusive**


Our exceptional and diverse people are the pulse and spirit of who we are. Every day, you will enrich your knowledge in an environment where differences in thought, creativity and experiences are embraced.


**About Us**
------------


We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all.


Global in outlook, local in practice – and with a united, shared passion for discovering solutions, we hire talented, driven people and support them to succeed, personally and professionally.

  

  

SLB is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.


We will endeavor to make a reasonable accommodation / modification to the known physical or mental limitations of a qualified applicant with a disability to assist in the hiring process, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local law. If you believe you require such assistance to complete this form or to participate in the interview process, please contact accommodationhotline@slb.com to request assistance. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to.


SLB is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor\- priority referral Protected Veterans requested.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**\*\*This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have the unrestricted right to work in the UK to be considered\*\***

**Overview**

You’ll be a senior member of the Engineering Reliability Team that will work closely with Zen’s development, engineering, and operations centre teams. You’ll Work alongside the Development and engineering teams, to support, maintain, and consistently improve the development estate so the development teams can focus and innovate constantly to drive Zen’s business and the teams’ priorities.

Reporting to the DevOps team manager, you must have an excellent track record in DevOps roles and the drive and attitude to succeed. Zen are committed to investing in and developing you – we believe that everyone can lead and the way we do has a huge impact on our people and play a vital part in our success.

The DevOps team will be responsible for the design and implementation of applications' build, release, deployment and configuration activities. Other responsibilities include working within multi\-functional teams to gather requirements, evaluate tools, implementing/updating solutions, building and executing test plans, provision environments, application performance reviews, assist migration of Legacy systems, and triaging and fixing operational issues.

You’ll ensure incidents are run smoothly and ensure that operational knowledge is available and shared. As a senior you will be a point of escalation, demonstrating problem solving skills, the ability to learn quickly and adapt your skills and knowledge.

As a service provider we operate many technologies, so you’ll have the skills to work with experienced Lead DevOps engineers, Systems Engineers and developers leveraging frameworks, standards, and defined operational process to make the unfamiliar comfortable and familiar. Over time we’ll increasingly leverage SRE principles to further optimize and enhance capabilities – it’s a great opportunity to get in at the start and shape this journey.

**Objectives**

* Deliver continuous incremental improvement of systems and infrastructure
* Take end to end ownership and responsibility for development infrastructure and systems
* Be a technical escalation point and eventually be part of a 24/7 escalation rota
* Document as you go – enough so your colleagues can follow what’s been done and why
* Drive tasks forward with energy and enthusiasm
* Create proactive monitoring solutions using standard tooling \- mainly Zabbix and Elastic
* Conduct RCA (Root Cause Analysis) for incidents
* Develop standard operational procedures and documentation
* Develop and maintain self\-managing infrastructure services and dashboards.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities
* Provide advice on DevOps standards and practices

· Provide coaching and mentoring to Software and DevOps Engineer peers

**Key Responsibilities**

**Experience**

· Worked and succeeded as a DevOps Engineer

· Ideally, experience working in an ISP, Telco or other Managed Services environment or able to demonstrate experience in a complex heterogeneous environment

· Strong adaptable scripting experience – ideally C\#/JavaScript/typescript/.Net

· Comfortable working with automation tools (Azure DevOps, GitLab, Puppet)

· Worked in complex networking and firewall environments

· Production use of multiple AWS capabilities and Kubernetes debugging

· Demonstratable experience in dealing with technical debt effectively

· Comfortable working with SRE principles and lean methodologies

**Skills \- Essential**

* Very strong problem\-solving skills are essential – understanding of DevOps and SRE concepts with the ability to apply key techniques to unfamiliar problems
* Ability to influence others in matters of standards and best practice, especially individuals outside of our team
* Comfortable working with automation tools (Puppet, Git) and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) with complex integrations and test frameworks
* Experience using containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes etc)
* Comfortable with Elasticsearch log standardisation, Kibana dashboard creation and data analysis skills
* Able to code to a good level \- this isn’t a developer role but you need scripting skills to succeed
* AWS hands on – Cloud formation, Route53, S3, DynamoDB, Cloud\-watch, Lambda, Security, and troubleshooting
* Certificate management and automation
* Strong troubleshooting and diagnosis skills
* Able to write documentation that covers what your peers and operations need to know
* Knowledge of Database systems and models
* Windows Server, SQL Server, IIS and Linux

**Interpersonal Skills**

We value interpersonal skills and responsible teamwork. You should be able to:

* Patient \& friendly with excellent interpersonal skills \- demonstrate a natural aptitude for dealing with people
* Influence and lead
* Strong attention to detail
* Happy working and supporting a small closeknit team
* Take and give feedback to tune future actions and behaviours
* Embrace and demonstrate Zen values
* Be kind, understanding, and listen to others
* Be organized

**Impact You'll Make**

You will be influencing and contributing to Zen’s long\-term goals and joining a family that believes business should be a force for good. We’re a company committed to improving the lives of our people, creating a better future through our community and charity work, and ensuring that we look after our environment.

Perhaps that’s why we’re officially a Great Place to Work and have achieved Carbon Neutral Plus status and B Corp Certification!

Pay: £58,000\.00\-£66,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Bereavement leave
* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
* Employee mentoring programme
* Enhanced maternity leave
* Free parking
* Life insurance
* Paid volunteer time
* Sick pay
* Work from home

Work Location: In person
