jobs.title: IT Partnering and Innovation Developer
jobs.description:
Higher education is undergoing a revolution, and Lancaster University is helping to lead it. As one of the world’s top universities, we have a strong tradition of innovation, and our future will be shaped by the opportunities created by new technologies.


Information Systems Services is seeking a Developer to join our Innovation Team.


Digital innovation is at the heart of our strategy and ambition. In the Innovation Team, we are focused on developing new ways of delivering the best experience possible for all our students and staff, whether they are based at our green Campus or located at home, wherever that may be in the world. Joining us is your chance to help lead the transformation.


**The Opportunity**


We are searching for a developer, to play a role in our creative and forward\-thinking team. The main purpose of this role is to be a developer throughout the full development stack on our innovation and mobile solutions. You will need to work with cloud and on\-premise development tools and framework, be able to mentor temporary staff in best practice and be willing to work across a range of emerging frameworks.


**What you will need**


You must have experience in programming languages and frameworks of C\# and React and have some experience of working with AWS and Azure. Experience of GIT for source code management and revision control.


Please refer to the included job description and person specification for further details of essential and desirable qualifications for the role.


The role is primarily based on the Lancaster University Bailrigg campus, with flexible hybrid working options to support a positive work\-life balance. We would expect a minimum of 3 days a week in the office, working flexibly to adapt to the needs of the role.


**So why us?**


You would be joining an agile, innovative team working to provide applications and services which have high impact and visibility. We are committed to supporting our new team members including students and have built an environment that fosters knowledge sharing and consideration of others.


This is a great opportunity for an experienced developer to have a transformative impact on the student experience of digital learning and further their own career with a global leader in Higher Education.


Please contact Brian Green (brian.green@lancaster.ac.uk), Head of Innovation and Mobile Development, if you have any questions and would like to informally discuss the role.

jobs.description:
**Ready to launch your career?**

  

Join Amey and **start building a career with real impact.**

  

We are excited to offer a fantastic opportunity for a Civil Engineer Graduate to join our NMC NE team based in Perth. Whether you are finishing university or looking for the next step in your career, this is a great place to develop your skills, confidence and future career.

 **Starting Salary:** £30,000\.00 per annum (Subject to review)

**Location****:** Caledonian House, West Kinfauns, Perth. PH2 7XZ

**Working hours per week:** Monday to Friday, 9\.00 am to 5\.00 pm, 40 hours per week.

**Start date****:** July 2027

  

Our two\-year Graduate Pathway will challenge and inspire you to reach your full potential and build your career, with a guaranteed permanent position to transition into on completion. Throughout the programme, you will receive first\-class mentoring and structured learning and development to support your professional and personal growth. We will also contribute towards a relevant professional qualification.

 **About the team:**


Join our supportive and inclusive team within NMC NE, where you will work on projects that make a real difference to communities across the UK.

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Growth Operations Engineer to join our innovative team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of optimizing our technical infrastructure, ensuring seamless deployment, scaling, and maintenance of our growth\-focused platforms. * Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure using tools such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and OpenStack to support growth initiatives.

* Familiarity with database systems including MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database or T\-SQL for data management.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP protocols, firewalls, DNS, WAN/LAN configurations and TCP socket programming.
* Experience with DevOps practices such as continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), release management and system testing.

* Ability to gather requirements effectively through collaboration with cross\-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.

jobs.title: Acoustic Modelling & Simulation Engineer (for projects in Sweden)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services to accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society.


AFRY employs over 18,000 professionals in more than 50 countries. Net sales in 2024 were SEK 27,160 million.


AFRY is organized into three Divisions: Energy; Industry and Transportation \& Places.


The Global Division Transportation \& Places is active within transportation infrastructure, real estate, water and environment in the Nordics and Central Europe. The division has about 6,500 employees and is structured around two segments: Road \& Rail and Public \& Commercial Places.

 **Job Description**  

At AFRY, we believe that sound has the power to shape how people experience the places where they live, work and meet.


We are now looking for an Acoustician with a strong background in building acoustics and environmental noise to join our growing Acoustics, Sound and Vibration team in Sweden, with around 80 acousticians across the country.


This is an opportunity for an ambitious acoustic engineer who wants to work on challenging projects, collaborate with leading specialists across disciplines and contribute to projects both in Sweden and internationally.


As an Acoustician at AFRY, you will work with a broad range of projects within building acoustics and environmental noise. You will be involved from early\-stage studies and concept development through detailed design and construction.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Building acoustics and acoustic design of residential, office, educational, healthcare and public buildings
* Environmental noise assessments related to road and rail traffic, industry and urban development
* Acoustic calculations, modelling and simulations
* Noise mapping and prediction
* Evaluation of acoustic measurements
* Development of acoustic solutions, strategies and mitigation measures
* Preparation of technical specifications
* Providing expert advice to project teams


You will have the opportunity to work across the full project lifecycle and develop your expertise in the areas where you can create the greatest value.

 **Qualifications** **Must have:**

* A university degree in acoustics, engineering, physics, building physics or a related field
* 5\+ years of professional experience as an acoustician or acoustic consultant
* Solid experience in building acoustics and/or environmental noise
* Experience of acoustic calculations, modelling and technical analysis
* Experience working in multidisciplinary construction or infrastructure projects
* The ability to communicate complex acoustic issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* A structured and independent way of working
* Strong written and spoken English


Experience in building acoustics within **healthcare projects** is particularly valuable.


Experience with software such as SoundPLAN, CadnaA, CadnaB, SONArchitect, INSUL, Bastian, Odeon, Treble, Rhino/Grasshopper, Sketchup, AutoCAD, Revit, BIM is an advantage. Experience with equivalent tools is also highly relevant.


Knowledge of Swedish acoustic standards and regulations is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.


Knowledge and experience within the following areas are particularly valuable:

* Façade and window sound insulation calculations with respect to road and rail traffic noise
* Airborne sound insulation calculations between rooms
* Impact sound insulation calculations between rooms
* Preparation of drawings and documentation specifying acoustic requirements for walls, glazed partitions and doors
* Sound transmission calculations between rooms, including break\-in and break\-out noise through ventilation ducts
* Noise assessment of air handling units and ventilation fan systems
* Room acoustic simulations and calculations, including reverberation time and Speech Transmission Index (STI).

  

**Additional Information**  

To individuals who join our team, we offer:

* Employment based on an employment contract
* Private medical insurance, life assurance, sport card (Multisport) and a social found
* 50% tax\-deductible costs for income from creative activities managed by the employer
* Exciting and challenging projects
* Personal development opportunities
* Friendly working atmosphere in a multidisciplinary and international team
* Helping to shape a sustainable future


Available office locations for this position are either in Poznań, Kraków or Łódź. We are ﬂexible on the office location for this position, please indicate your preference in your covering letter. We value a healthy work life balance and are committed to your wellbeing. We will operate a hybrid working environment.

*We are excited to receive your application,* ***please ensure your CV is in English****.*


Should you be successful you will be invited for a telephone interview followed by a 2 steps virtual or live face to face interview.

*At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.*

Nexio Management to około 550 konsultantów, którzy od ponad 20 lat tworzą zaawansowane rozwiązania IT dla firm w Polsce i za granicą. Jesteśmy zespołem ekspertów, którzy realnie angażują się w projekty swoich klientów.
  

  

Specjalizujemy się w budowie, rozwoju i utrzymaniu systemów i aplikacji, oraz doradztwie IT. Wierzymy, że najlepsze rozwiązania powstają wtedy, gdy jest przestrzeń na eksperymentowanie \- dlatego mamy własne R\&D Center na czele z NexioBot naszym mobilnym robotem asystującym, wykorzystującym sztuczną inteligencję do komunikacji.
  

  

Działamy w takich modelach biznesowych jak managed services, fixed prices oraz wspieramy zespoły naszych klientów w modelach scale up the team. Naszymi klientami są firmy z wielu zróżnicowanych branż, szukające wsparcia najwyższej klasy ekspertów.


**Opis stanowiska**
-------------------


Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy **Architekta IT / Software Architecta**, który będzie odpowiedzialny za projektowanie i rozwój architektury systemów oraz wsparcie zespołów deweloperskich w procesie transformacji technologicznej.


Szukamy osoby, która dobrze odnajduje się na stykutechnologii i biznesu, potrafi podejmować samodzielne decyzje architektoniczne, ale jednocześnie potrafi przełożyć je na konkretne rozwiązania i jasno wyjaśnić ich uzasadnienie.

jobs.title: Software Engineer-Flight Operations
jobs.description:
As a Software Engineer, you will work with your team on development of new features for the Avinode Flight Operations product offering. As a member of a product team made up of a Product Manager, UX Designer, Test Lead, and Software Engineers, you will plan, implement, and release business\-critical features for customers across the business aviation industry.

**What you will do**

* Working together with your teammates, develop appropriate technical solutions to implement new product features and improve current features. You will be working both in our existing C\# .NET monolith and React frontend as well as potentially developing new services.
* Work to bring our codebase up to date with current best practices, libraries, and platforms.
* Research and advocate for new technologies and techniques that would be beneficial to your team and/or the wider Engineering organisation.

**Who you are**

* You have 3\+ years of experience building systems in the .NET ecosystem and React frontends. You may be more specialised in the frontend or backend, but you will be expected to contribute to all parts of the stack when necessary.
* You have some experience working with relational databases and related technologies such as ORMs, and some proficiency with SQL (we use MS SQL Server, but experience with Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, etc. is fine).
* You are familiar with software development and delivery best practices, and are committed to consistently following the team’s standard practices.
* You communicate well. With offices in multiple time zones and multiple countries, this position requires strong written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Stillingsbeskrivelse**
------------------------


Er du en engasjert tech\-entusiast som elsker å jobbe med moderne datateknologier? Hos Sopra Steria blir du en del av et inspirerende og inkluderende miljø – et av Norges råeste tech\-miljøer – hvor vi kombinerer utfordrende prosjekter med en kultur preget av nysgjerrighet, læring og samarbeid. Vi tror at du, med din evne til å tilegne deg ny kunnskap og din genuine interesse for teknologi, vil trives og vokse hos oss. Hos oss vil du bidra i varierte oppdrag på tvers av bransjer og sektorer, og være med på å utvikle morgendagens dataløsninger sammen med noen av Norges fremste fageksperter  

  

  

Her får du muligheten til å forme morgendagens dataløsninger i et dynamisk team med høyt kvalifiserte kollegaer.

**Ansvarsområder**:


* **Utvikling og design**  

Du vil være med å designe og sette opp event\-drevne arkitekturer. Ved å integrere meldingstjenester som Kafka og Pub/Sub, oppnår vi sanntids databehandling, rask respons og en robust, hendelsesbasert arkitektur som gir oss økt fleksibilitet og effektivitet.
* **Dataprosessering**  

Du jobber med distribuerte plattformer for å prosessere store datamengder. Dette innebærer avansert datamodellering for å strukturere, transformere og gjøre data om til verdifull innsikt.
* **Skyteknologier**  

Vil du være med å designe, sette opp og optimalisere løsninger på Azure, AWS og GCP? Her utnytter du tjenester for lagring, serverless computing og containere for å bygge systemer som er sikre, skalerbare og kostnadseffektive.
* **Infrastruktur som kode**  

Du vil være med på å designe og implementere skyinfrastruktur ved hjelp av moderne IaC\-verktøy, som Terraform, Biceps og tilsvarende.

  

I prosjektene våre vil du kombinere denne tekniske kompetansen med evnen til å forstå kundens behov, samarbeide godt med ulike fagmiljøer og levere løsninger som er robuste, optimaliserte og som skaper tydelig verdi for kundene våre.

**Kvalifikasjoner**:

* Høyere utdanning innen IT, dataingeniørfag eller beslektede fagområder.
* Minimum to års relevant arbeidserfaring med dataplattformer.
* Erfaring med distribuerte systemer og skyteknologier.
* Gode programmeringsferdigheter, spesielt i Python. Erfaring med Go, Kotlin, C\# eller Java er en fordel.

Hos oss får du jobbe med meningsfulle og varierte prosjekter for noen av Norges største virksomheter. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer for Vacuum Technology (TE-VSC-BVO-2026-155-GRAP)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Join CERN's Vacuum, Surfaces and Coatings Group and contribute to engineering projects supporting the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) experiments.


As a Mechanical Engineer in the Experimental Vacuum team, you will work on the design, development, production and testing of ultra\-high vacuum equipment around the ATLAS, ALICE, CMS and LHCb experiments.


You will take part in projects from initial engineering concepts through design, simulation and prototyping to testing, installation and operational follow\-up. Working alongside engineers, technicians and specialists from other disciplines, you will gain hands\-on experience with complex mechanical systems in a unique scientific environment.

**Your responsibilities**

* Design and develop precision mechanical equipment for ultra\-high vacuum applications.
* Create 3D CAD models and perform structural, thermal and modal analyses to validate designs.
* Follow projects through design, prototyping, manufacturing, assembly and testing.
* Plan and carry out laboratory tests, including leak detection, residual gas analysis and vacuum performance measurements.
* Work with CERN workshops, suppliers and technical teams to support production and quality control.
* Contribute to the installation, commissioning and improvement of vacuum equipment for the LHC experiments.
* Collaborate across engineering disciplines to solve technical challenges and deliver reliable solutions.

**Your profile**

* Mechanical design and CAD (CATIA, Autodesk Inventor, SolidWorks or similar).
* Engineering simulation and analysis (ANSYS or similar).
* Precision mechanics, manufacturing, assembly or testing.
* Vacuum technology or laboratory environments.
* Experience with ultra\-high vacuum systems, leak detection or residual gas analysis is an advantage, but you do not need experience in all these areas.


Skills

* Good foundation in mechanical engineering and design.
* Interest in developing expertise in ultra\-high vacuum and precision engineering.
* Practical, curious and solution\-oriented approach.
* Clear communication and commitment to high\-quality engineering.
* Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.


Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* You have a professional background in Mechanical Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
	+ a **Master's degree with 2 to 6 years** of post\-graduation professional experience;
	+ or a **PhD with no more than 3 years** of post\-graduation professional experience.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

  

**Additional Information**  

Job closing date: **19\.10\.2026 at 23:59 CEST.**


Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.


Working hours: 40 hours per week


Job flexibility: Fully Onsite


Target start date: 01\-January\-2027


This position involves:

* Work in Radiation Areas.
* Interventions in underground installations.


Job reference: TE\-VSC\-BVO\-2026\-155\-GRAP


Field of work: Mechanical Engineering


Benchmark job: 200090 \- Mechanical Engineer

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On\-the\-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN \- Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**


At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

jobs.title: Global Solutions Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Dimensions**:


The Global Solutions Developer is in the HWS Information Systems group and will work closely with many functional groups within the HWS business, including manufacturing, supply chain, quality and finance to design and deliver solutions in alignment with the HWS global strategic direction. The primary responsibility of this role is for functional application design and deployment of new and modified solutions for ad\-hoc application modules globally that fit the need(s) of the business.

 **Major Activities \& Key Challenges:**

* Perform self\-audit activities along with process documentation development, update and review
* Support existing processes and solutions
* Specific area responsibility will center on global process improvements surrounding inventory, quality, maintenance, engineering, etc. and custom bolt\-on client applications developed in PL/SQL and Microsoft C\#
* Evaluate business problems and processes, evaluate requirements, scope, functionality, priorities – provide recommended solution alternatives in alignment with business objectives
* Development of project requirements, including detailed specs, work estimates, timelines, deliverables and milestones. This includes plan development for small to medium sized projects. Provide leadership and direction to other work teams, such as Howmet Aerospace Corporate workgroups
* Develops an in\-depth understanding of the business processes in their area(s) of assignment, and a general understanding of the Howmet Wheel Systems business
* Pursues continuous learning consistent with changes in technology, and uses this to influence IS direction
* Leverage day\-to\-day interaction and activities to identify process improvement opportunities, sharing knowledge with other team members;
* Provide systems expertise in the solutions area assigned. This includes providing support to sustaining activities and to project activities for the assigned area.

 **Environment, Health \& Safety Requirements;** Detail on the working conditions/ environment of this role, any physical demands, who they are working with, and safety (bullet points):

* Comply with all local, corporate and regulatory environmental, health and safety protocols and procedures at Howmet facilities and non\-Howmet operations where we have IT infrastructure.
* Ensure IT staff and contractors that are performing IT work also adhere to these rules.
* Bachelor’s Degree (in an IT or Engineering related field) from an accredited institution
* Eagerness to learn
* Strong attention to detail
* Time management with the ability to balance multiple tasks and meet project deadlines
* Excellent problem solving, collaboration, and analytical skills
* Experience in full\-stack development and other software development projects
* Experience working within Microsoft Visual Studio
* Experience in SQL, Python, C\#, JavaScript

 **Preferred Qualifications**:

* Experience working within Microsoft Visual Studio
* Experience in SQL, Python, C\#, JavaScript

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated and technically capable **Junior Software Engineer** to join our IT team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining, testing, and supporting software applications and internal digital solutions used across the Group's business operations.

The role will involve working closely with different departments to understand business requirements, improve existing systems, develop software solutions, troubleshoot technical issues, and support the continuous digitalization and automation of business processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, maintain, test, and implement software applications and internal business solutions.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into practical software solutions.
* Develop and maintain web\-based applications, internal systems, and business tools.
* Assist in integrating different systems, applications, databases, and third\-party platforms.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software\-related issues in a timely manner.
* Maintain and improve existing software applications and databases.
* Develop reports, dashboards, forms, and automated workflows according to business requirements.
* Ensure software applications are reliable, secure, scalable, and user\-friendly.
* Perform software testing and quality checks before deployment.
* Maintain technical documentation, system documentation, and application specifications.
* Assist with database management, data validation, and data migration when required.
* Investigate system errors and coordinate with IT vendors or external developers when necessary.
* Provide technical support and guidance to users regarding software applications.
* Monitor application performance and recommend improvements.
* Follow software development standards, IT security policies, and company procedures.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies, programming languages, development tools, and software engineering practices.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering**, or a related field.
* Minimum **5 years of relevant experience in software development or a similar position**.
* Previous experience working with business applications, ERP systems, or enterprise software is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of software development principles and practices.
* Good understanding of database concepts.
* Experience with web application development and APIs.
* Knowledge of software testing, debugging, version control, and system integration.
* Candidates should have practical knowledge of the following:
* **Programming:** C\#, .NET, Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.
* **Web Development:** HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Angular, or similar frameworks. **Database:** Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar databases.
* **APIs \& Integration:** REST APIs, web services, and system integrations.
* **Version Control:** Git or similar tools.
* **Reporting:** Power BI, SSRS, or other reporting and dashboard tools.
* **ERP / Business Systems:** Experience supporting or integrating ERP and business management systems is preferred.
* **Cloud Technologies:** Basic knowledge of Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud platforms an advantage.
* **Automation:** Knowledge of workflow automation and business process automation is an advantage.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into technical solutions.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Good command of written and spoken English.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer III, Programming Foundations
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join the Programming Foundations Team within Amazon Builder Experience as a Software Development Engineer. The Language Experience team in Builder Tools is the center of excellence for Amazon's use of programming languages, highly\-leveraged shared software, and application build tools.  

  

Our tools are used in all aspects of the business, and their care and evolution are of critical importance to the effectiveness of Amazon. We're looking for a deeply technical leader interested in sustaining and evolving the shared software platform used by nearly every service within the company. Those with experience evolving broadly distributed and highly complex software libraries, such as large open source projects and mission critical foundational software stacks will be given an opportunity to have company wide impact.  

Amazon Builder Experience is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

You will design and build developer tools that Amazon engineers use every day. You will work with the languages and libraries that power Amazon's services, making them easier to use and more reliable. You will help maintain our build tools, compilers and package managers. You will work on our 3PSW repository mirrors. You will collaborate with engineers across Amazon to understand their pain points and build tools that address them. You will write code, review code from teammates, and help others debug issues with our tools.  

  

A day in the life  

Your work will directly affect how builders at Amazon do their jobs. We are a language expertise team at the heart of being able to compile and shift software. This is practical work that requires understanding what builders actually need and building tools that solve their problems without getting in the way.  

  

About the team  

The Programming Foundations Team is part of Amazon Builder Experience. We work on the basic tools and infrastructure that builders use to write software. Our team includes engineers who care about developer experience and want to make building software at Amazon easier. We do not own customer\-facing products directly, but our work affects every team that builds software at Amazon. We focus on doing useful work rather than flashy projects. If you like building tools that help other engineers and want to work on problems that span the whole company, this team might be a good fit.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience in professional, non\-internship software development
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* Experience in development in the last 3 years

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

new_jobs.title: Technisch Consultant / Product Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Over OCTOBOX**

OCTOBOX is een innovatief softwarebedrijf dat oplossingen ontwikkelt voor centrale en lokale overheden. Onze software helpt organisaties bij het beheren van informatie, het verwerken van (gevoelige) gegevens en het voldoen aan wetgeving zoals ‘Open op Orde’ en de ‘Wet open overheid’. We maken complexe informatiehuishouding beheersbaar en toegankelijk door het automatiseren van processen rondom data\-analyse, publicatie en archivering.

Binnen OCTOBOX heerst een moderne en dynamisch cultuur waarin autonomie, innovatie en klantgerichtheid centraal staan. Ter versterking van ons team zoeken we een Technisch Consultant / Product Engineer die functionele ontwerpen weet te vertalen naar slimme technische oplossingen binnen onze low\-code product platform.

**Jouw rol** 

Als Product Engineer ben jij de technische schakel binnen onze projectteams. Je vertaalt functionele ontwerpen door gebruik te maken van onze softwaresuite naar een technische oplossingen, en realiseert maatwerk waar nodig. Je werkt met onze low\-code suite en schakelt (indien nodig) moeiteloos over op C\#\-scripting voor specifieke klantwensen. Jouw werk zorgt ervoor dat systemen correct gekoppeld zijn, data stroomt zoals bedoeld, en onze oplossingen en functionaliteiten probleemloos functioneren in de klantomgeving.

Samen met implementatieconsultants, projectmanagers en ontwikkelaars draag je bij aan een soepele en schaalbare oplevering van onze projecten – altijd binnen planning en volgens technische standaarden.

**Wat je gaat doen**

* Configureren en inrichten van onze softwareproducten op basis van low/no\-code technologie.
* Realiseren van technische maatwerkcomponenten in C\# wanneer standaardfuncties tekortschieten.
* Inrichten, testen en beheren van koppelingen met externe systemen zoals DMS’en, zaaksystemen en databronnen (via REST API’s e.a.).
* Voorbereiden en uitvoeren van technische installaties, updates en migraties.
* Vertalen van functionele specificaties naar robuuste technische implementaties.
* Signaleren en oplossen van technische issues in samenwerking met collega’s uit het ontwikkelteam.
* Documenteren van technische keuzes en inrichting voor overdraagbaarheid en beheer.
* Intensief samenwerken met projectstakeholders gedurende alle fasen van een project.
* Uitvoeren van functionele en technische tests om de kwaliteit en werking van jouw configuraties en koppelingen te waarborgen.
* Bijdragen aan het releaseproces binnen onze DevOps\-werkwijze, waaronder het voorbereiden, testen, documenteren en begeleiden van releases.

**Wat je meebrengt**

* Een afgeronde hbo\-opleiding in een technische richting (zoals Informatica of Software Engineering).
* Ervaring met low\-code of no\-code configuraties binnen softwareplatforms.
* Praktische kennis van C\#\-scripting en het bouwen van maatwerklogica.
* Ervaring met REST API’s, JSON, XML, en authenticatieprotocollen zoals OAuth of SAML.
* Bekendheid met applicatie\-installaties binnen Server/Microsoft\-omgevingen.
* Basiskennis van SQL, PowerShell of DevOps\-tools is mooi meegenomen.
* Ervaring met informatiesystemen of ECM's in de publieke sector is een pré.

**Wie jij bent**

* Een gestructureerde technicus met een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen.
* Zorgvuldig, kwaliteitsgericht en nauwkeurig in je werk.
* Een teamspeler die effectief samenwerkt met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines.
* Zelfstandig in je aanpak, met eigenaarschap over je taken.
* Leergierig en nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en methodes.
* Je vindt het belangrijk om werk te doen met maatschappelijke impactvolle waarde: je draagt graag bij aan systemen en kritische projecten die overheidsorganisaties helpen transparanter, efficiënter en betrouwbaarder te functioneren.

Soort dienstverband: Fulltime, Parttime

Salaris: €3\.000,00 \- €5\.000,00 per maand

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Auto van de zaak
* Bedrijfsfeesten
* Budget voor professionele ontwikkeling
* Extra vakantiedagen
* Kerstpakket
* Pensioen
* Reiskostenvergoeding
* Telefoon van de zaak
* Werk vanuit huis

Opleiding:

* HBO (Gewenst)

Ervaring:

* IT\-ondersteuning: 3 jaar (Gewenst)
* AI: 1 jaar (Vereist)
* SQL: 2 jaar (Vereist)
* JSON: 2 jaar (Vereist)
* Projectimplementatie: 1 jaar (Gewenst)

Taal:

* Nederlands (Vereist)

Bereidheid om zakelijk te reizen:

* 50% (Gewenst)

Werklocatie: Hybride werken in 3441 Woerden

* Employer pension contribution of 28\.97% of your salary. Read more about Civil Service Pensions Contribution rates
* 25 days annual leave, increasing by 1 day each year of service (up to a maximum of 30 days annual leave), plus 8 bank holidays and a privilege day for the Kings birthday
* Flexible working options where we encourage a great work\-life balance.


Read more in the Benefits section below!


Find out more about what it's like working at Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency \- Department for Transport Careers.

### **Job description**


The Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) deliver wide reaching digital services to the UK public and industry. We maintain the national record of vehicles and drivers. If you have applied for a driving licence, changed vehicle, re\-licensed your vehicle or completed a vehicle enquiry you would have used one of our services.


The time is right to join one of the leading agile, cloud and technical departments in the government, one that is constantly pushing the boundaries of technological innovation to find, develop, and introduce new and innovative technological advancements. On a modern cloud platform, we work with a range of industry\-leading technologies, such as serverless, Docker, and Kubernetes.


If you are successful, you will be part of the new electronic Vehicle Excise Duty programme which is a new legislative, digital service being delivered by DVLA to modernise how Vehicle Excise Duty is administered and delivered digitally. This is an exciting time to join us!


Within and between our teams, we have a friendly and stable engineering community. Keeping work life enjoyable is key to us, and we strive to ensure the efficient and secure use of software and infrastructure.  

  

Our current deliveries include:

* Two major programmes of work, modernising our drivers and vehicles services and systems.
* Entirely new services including a new customer portal, mobile digital driving licence and identity platform.
* The DVLA digital payment service that helps us collect around 6 billion pounds a year.
* New versions of key driving licence services that will help us to reduce paper forms, reduce waiting times and to enable all of our customers to transact digitally.


As part of our core business services, you will work with Java and SpringBoot alongside tools like OpenAPI. No specific Java experience is needed. All you need is a passion for building clean, maintainable, and secure applications using an object\-oriented language.


If youre working on the front\-end, youll be developing applications and reusable components using a combination of Ruby on Rails and React. You will also have the opportunity to build and develop our external and internal UIs, so this is an exciting opportunity to deliver far reaching, intuitive and accessible front\-end systems.


As part of our ongoing mission to support and develop all staff within the DVLA, you will be given a high spec Macbook and we will help you to achieve certification in areas such as AWS and Java, as well as giving you the freedom and support necessary to perform in your role and continuously develop your skill set.


DVLA have been using AI coding assistants for over two years and actively encourage and support the appropriate use of AI coding tools. We have an AI coding group and are working together to understand how to use AI coding assistants responsibly to build better digital services.


Your responsibilities will include, but arent limited to:

* Working within a technical framework of the project to meet customer requirements.
* Developing Software in an agile team environment.
* Application Support.
* Working closely with business analysts and agile delivery managers to prepare and review user stories and tasks.
* Some testing responsibilities.
* Mentoring junior developers within the team.


Great line management is important to us as an organisation, and we will equip and support line managers to develop the skills they need. We aim to empower line managers to create teams where people can flourish and deliver excellent outcomes for the public.


For further information on the role, please read the attached role profile. Please note that the role profile is for information purposes only \- whilst all elements are relevant to the role, they may not all be assessed during the recruitment process. This job advert will detail exactly what will be assessed during the recruitment process.

### **Person specification**


Required experience:


To be successful in this role you will need to have the following experience:

* Working as a software engineer across multiple teams and projects, developing software using a variety of modern technologies and tools.
* A passion for back\-end, front\-end development, security or serverless technology.
* You will need to be comfortable in using modern CI/CD tooling with an understanding of languages such as Java, Ruby, C\#, HTML, Python or similar. As we develop, we are committed to the development of our employees, so we will help you achieve certification in these areas as well as AWS and Azure.
* You need to have a passion for modern software development technologies and standard methodologies.
* You would need to have had to communicate with engineering peers and business partners.

**Additional Information**


The role is part of the Government Digital and Data profession and utilises an enhanced CapabilityBased Pay Framework which provides access to a Digital and Data allowance.


The base pay is £44,241\. In addition to this the role includes a Digital and Data allowance of up to £14,756\.


The value of allowance awarded will be based on an assessment of your skills and experience as demonstrated through the selection process. Here are more details on the pay framework.

**Working for the DVLA Digital Team**


At DVLA, licensing is just the start. Every project you implement, touch and deliver has a ripple effect thatll wash across the nation. Here the work youre doing has the capacity to change the way 53 million people interact with our services. As we aim to keep our roads some of the safest in the world, our innovative, transformative digital\-led services help optimise a nation of individuals and business every single day.

This role is suitable for hybrid working, which is a non\-contractual arrangement where a combination of workplace and home\-based working can be accommodated subject to business requirements.

### **Technical skills**

------------

Passionate, reliable and always willing to push yourself and those around you, youll continue to seek improvement in your own role and challenge us too. Because we pride ourselves on how we approach your development. From training courses to specialist skills workshops and opportunities to grow your expertise, we thrive when you thrive. Our selection process ensures a comprehensive assessment of each applicant's qualifications, skills, and potential fit within our organisation.


The selection process for this role will be:


Stage 1: Sift of CV \& Personal statement


Stage 2: Interview

This job advert contains links to the DfT Careers website. Our website provides useful guidance and information that can support you during the application process. If you are experiencing accessibility problems with any attachments on this advert or the information on our website, please contact the email address in the 'Contact point for applicants' section.

**Further Information**


For more information about how we hire, and for useful tips on submitting your application for this role, visit the How We Hire page of our DfT Careers website. You can find detailed information about the recruitment process and what to expect when applying for a role.


For further information on National Security Vetting please visit the Demystifying Vetting website.

A candidate is not eligible to apply for a role within the Civil Service if the application is made within a 5\-year period following a dismissal for carrying out internal fraud against government.


All external applicants and current employees of accredited non\-departmental public bodies (NDPBs) will be required to undergo a Social Media Check. A Social Media Check is a review of your publicly available online activity, typically across platforms like LinkedIn, Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, and others. The purpose is to identify any public posts or content that could raise concerns for employers, such as:

* Hate speech or discriminatory behaviour
* Threats or acts of violence
* Illegal activity or substance misuse
* Sexually explicit material
* Extremist views or affiliations


Importantly, this check does not involve hacking into your accounts or accessing private messages. It only considers content you have chosen to make public. Employers use this kind of screening to help ensure their workplace remains safe, inclusive, and aligned with company values. Its not about judging your personality or lifestyle \- its about checking for potential red flags that might affect the role or company culture. Programme
Full Time Graduate
Career Path
Technology
Location
London
Start Date
September\-2027
### **Programme Description**


**What does this team do?**


Our Tax Consulting practice provides companies and high net worth individuals with advice on their tax, ensuring they remain compliant with regulations. From advising clients on investment tax to working with their innovation and property teams to ensure that the available tax reliefs are maximised, we help our clients make the right business decisions, on a worldwide scale.


A Tax Technology \& Engineering role, could mean the opportunity to work within one of the following teams:


**Digital Innovation – Digital Tax Solutions:** We are a pioneering team, committed to building cutting\-edge digital tax products and solutions. Leveraging an AI\-first approach to development, we discover, design, and deliver market\-leading innovation. We continuously experiment with new technologies to transform our business and drive revenue growth.


**Global Investments \& Innovation Incentives (Gi3\)**: The UK government offers generous tax incentives to companies operating across all areas of science, engineering and tech, to encourage investment in research and development. The Gi3 team is part of a global network of tech, engineering, science and financial specialists who work closely with companies of varying size (from start\-ups to large multinationals), helping them unlock these incentives for their innovations in chemicals, pharmaceuticals, oil and gas, manufacturing etc. This involves working closely with our clients to identify their eligible projects (and attributable expenditure), maximising the valuable incentives available.


Our team comprises specialists from both tax/financial and tech backgrounds, where engineers, scientists and IT/software technologists play a pivotal role in supporting our clients in unlocking the incentives available to them. We partner with clients working on some of the most exciting and innovative projects across all areas of science and technology.


**What skills and academic qualifications do I need?**


**Digital Innovation – Digital Tax Solutions**


We require you to demonstrate an interest in, or a degree related to, developing products, Computer Science or Software Engineering.


Related degree disciplines include:


* Computer games and animation.
* Information Systems.
* Computing.
* Engineering and technology.
* Cyber Security.

**Global Investment \& Innovation Incentives – Software Engineering:**


We require you to hold, or be working towards, a degree within a Computer Science, Software


Development/Software Engineering or related discipline.


Related degree disciplines include:


* Data Science.
* Mathematics.
* Electrical Engineering.
* Cyber Security.

**Global Investment \& Innovation Incentives – Engineering** (STEM)


We require you to have achieved, or be working towards, a degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics related degree discipline.


You’ll need to have obtained or be studying towards a minimum 2:1 degree as mentioned above and have graduated by September 2027 for the Autumn 2027 intake.


We have identified 10 core skills that are essential to all our roles in Early Careers. To learn more about these skills and their detailed descriptions, please visit the 'Discover What We Look For' section in our Candidate Zone.


**What kind of work will I do?**


By joining a student programme within Tax Technology \& Engineering, you will work with and learn from some of the most talented and experienced professionals in the industry.


You’ll have the opportunity to work with a range of clients, from FTSE 100 organisations to start\-ups and private individuals.


You’ll help them solve some of the most complex issues their business is ever likely to face. Many of our established clients are high profile, household names. You will play a key role in a multi\-disciplinary collaborative team and will learn about the UK's latest tech developments.


Depending on the area you join, you may be using your technical background to understand and support a client’s development activities or form the basis for their research and development, patent box claims and grant applications. Alternatively, by using cloud services and cutting\-edge technology (then applying it to the tax technology domain) you will support the build of software platforms to provide better business insight and efficiencies.


**Where will I work?**


At Deloitte we recognise how important face\-to\-face interaction is for your development in a new role. We also understand that our people need flexibility, which is why we operate a hybrid system, with a combination of office and home working. If you’re in a client\-facing role, you might be expected to attend client sites on certain days, while your meetings will be a mix of online and in\-person events. Please note your final assessment and induction will also be in\-person, to give you the opportunity to network and build relationships.


**All our workspaces are accessible, however, if you require further flexibility due to a health condition or caring responsibilities, please discuss this with our team. You can find further information on our** **parent and carer policies here.**


**How will I develop?**


We want our people to have worldclass practical experience coupled with the technical rigour and knowledge that comes from the right professional qualification.


We think the best experience is being immersed in client work, working alongside other team members, and learning the practical skills that will set you up for a successful career. That will be the initial focus whether you are a Graduate, an Industrial Placement, or a BrightStart, supported by internal training and support from coaches, people leaders, and your team.


We think this is vital and will set you up for success when we further support your development with a professional qualification, recognising that different roles across our business align to different pathways. These may include options such as joint or accelerated programmes leading to qualifications like Association of Taxation Technicians (ATT), Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA), Institute of Chartered Accountants of Scotland (ICAS) or Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA), as well as other more specialist routes focused on tax or technical expertise.


**Additional support and benefits information**


* We’re a collaborative, inclusive firm and we want to help you to use your unique talents and perspectives in the workplace. From diversity networks to wellbeing and much more, we aim to support and reward you in the best way possible. Please use the links below to discover more about our processes, benefits, values and culture.
* You can learn more about the full recruitment process here.
* Do you have accessibility requirements or need reasonable adjustments for the interview or assessment process? Find out how we can help.
* Learn more about our values, culture and purpose as a firm.
* Want to hear from some of our people to inspire your future career? Check out our Life at Deloitte page.
* At Deloitte we value diversity, and we’re committed to ensuring that our people thrive through a wide range of initiatives and diversity networks. Discover more about inclusion and wellbeing.
* We value our people and recognise their hard work. Learn about the rewards and benefits available at Deloitte.

**Application deadlines**


**Application deadlines:** There is no specific deadline for this role, but we recommend getting your application in as soon as possible. Please note, some of our roles may close quickly if we experience high demand.


**Assessment deadlines:** Once you’ve applied to this role, you’ll receive an email from our recruitment team outlining next steps and the relevant deadlines for you to complete the following stages of our process.


We operate a strict one application per year policy across our Early Careers opportunities. We recommend only submitting an application for a role that you feel is right for you.


**Visa Sponsorship**


We accept applications from candidates who are currently on student visas for this role. We cannot accept applications from candidates who have previously spent time on a Skilled Worker or Graduate visa. If successful to offer, you must stay on your student visa until our immigration team contacts you c.3 months before your start date. See our Work Permits page for more information.


**What matters to you? Make it happen at Deloitte.**

We continuously experiment with new technologies to transform our business and drive revenue growth.


**Global Investments \& Innovation Incentives (Gi3\)**: The UK government offers generous tax incentives to companies operating across all areas of science, engineering and tech, to encourage investment in research and development. The Gi3 team is part of a global network of tech, engineering, science and financial specialists who work closely with companies of varying size (from start\-ups to large multinationals), helping them unlock these incentives for their innovations in chemicals, pharmaceuticals, oil and gas, manufacturing etc. This involves working closely with our clients to identify their eligible projects (and attributable expenditure), maximising the valuable incentives available.


Our team comprises specialists from both tax/financial and tech backgrounds, where engineers, scientists and IT/software technologists play a pivotal role in supporting our clients in unlocking the incentives available to them. We partner with clients working on some of the most exciting and innovative projects across all areas of science and technology.


**What skills and academic qualifications do I need?**


**Digital Innovation – Digital Tax Solutions**


We require you to demonstrate an interest in, or a degree related to, developing products, Computer Science or Software Engineering.


Related degree disciplines include:


* Computer games and animation.
* Information Systems.
* Computing.
* Engineering and technology.
* Cyber Security.

**Global Investment \& Innovation Incentives – Software Engineering:**


We require you to hold, or be working towards, a degree within a Computer Science, Software


Development/Software Engineering or related discipline.


Related degree disciplines include:


* Data Science.
* Mathematics.
* Electrical Engineering.
* Cyber Security.

**Global Investment \& Innovation Incentives – Engineering** (STEM)


We require you to have achieved, or be working towards, a degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics related degree discipline.


This programme is for university students who are doing well academically and want to test their skills in the real world. You’ll be on track to achieve a predicted degree classification of 2:1 in the discipline areas mentioned above. You must also be in the penultimate year of your course.


We have identified 10 core skills that are essential to all our roles in Early Careers. To learn more about these skills and their detailed descriptions, please visit the 'Discover What We Look For' section in our Candidate Zone.


**What kind of work will I do?**


By joining a student programme within Tax Technology \& Engineering, you will work with and learn from some of the most talented and experienced professionals in the industry.


You’ll have the opportunity to work with a range of clients, from FTSE 100 organisations to start\-ups and private individuals.


You’ll help them solve some of the most complex issues their business is ever likely to face. Many of our established clients are high profile, household names. You will play a key role in a multi\-disciplinary collaborative team and will learn about the UK's latest tech developments.


Depending on the area you join, you may be using your technical background to understand and support a client’s development activities or form the basis for their research and development, patent box claims and grant applications. Alternatively, by using cloud services and cutting\-edge technology (then applying it to the tax technology domain) you will support the build of software platforms to provide better business insight and efficiencies.


**Where will I work?**


At Deloitte we recognise how important face\-to\-face interaction is for your development in a new role. We also understand that our people need flexibility, which is why we operate a hybrid system, with a combination of office and home working. If you’re in a client\-facing role, you might be expected to attend client sites on certain days, while your meetings will be a mix of online and in\-person events. Please note your final assessment and induction will also be in\-person, to give you the opportunity to network and build relationships.


**All our workspaces are accessible, however, if you require further flexibility due to a health condition or caring responsibilities, please discuss this with our team. You can find further information on our** **parent and carer policies here.**


**How will I develop?**

We want our people to have worldclass practical experience coupled with the technical rigour and knowledge that comes from the right professional qualification.


We think the best experience is being immersed in client work, working alongside other team members, and learning the practical skills that will set you up for a successful career. That will be the initial focus whether you are a Graduate, an Industrial Placement, or a BrightStart, supported by internal training and support from coaches, people leaders, and your team.


We think this is vital and will set you up for success when we further support your development with a professional qualification, recognising that different roles across our business align to different pathways. These may include options such as joint or accelerated programmes leading to qualifications like Association of Taxation Technicians (ATT), Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA), Institute of Chartered Accountants of Scotland (ICAS) or Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA), as well as other more specialist routes focused on tax or technical expertise.


**Additional support and benefits information**

* We’re a collaborative, inclusive firm and we want to help you to use your unique talents and perspectives in the workplace. From diversity networks to wellbeing and much more, we aim to support and reward you in the best way possible. Please use the links below to discover more about our processes, benefits, values and culture.
* You can learn more about the full recruitment process here.
* Do you have accessibility requirements or need reasonable adjustments for the interview or assessment process? Find out how we can help.
* Learn more about our values, culture and purpose as a firm.
* Want to hear from some of our people to inspire your future career? Check out our Life at Deloitte page.
* At Deloitte we value diversity, and we’re committed to ensuring that our people thrive through a wide range of initiatives and diversity networks. Discover more about inclusion and wellbeing.
* We value our people and recognise their hard work. Learn about the rewards and benefits available at Deloitte.

**Application deadlines**

**Application deadlines:** There is no specific deadline for this role, but we recommend getting your application in as soon as possible. Please note, some of our roles may close quickly if we experience high demand.


**Assessment deadlines:** Once you’ve applied to this role, you’ll receive an email from our recruitment team outlining next steps and the relevant deadlines for you to complete the following stages of our process.


We operate a strict one application per year policy across our Early Careers opportunities. We recommend only submitting an application for a role that you feel is right for you.


**Visa Sponsorship**


We’re not able to provide visa sponsorship for this programme. However, you can apply if you hold a Student Visa which is valid for the duration. If you are currently on a student visa and would require sponsorship to join Deloitte after graduation, we are able to accept your application for this role.


**What matters to you? Make it happen at Deloitte.**

**United Kingdom, Aberdeen**
----------------------------

Apply Now **Job Title**
**Field Engineer Trainee (****Completions \& Well Intervention)**  

**About Us**
We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. At SLB we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. We are facing the world’s greatest balancing act\- how to simultaneously reduce emissions and meet the world’s growing energy demands. Our collective future depends on decarbonizing the fossil fuel industry, while innovating a new energy landscape. It’s what drives us. Ensuring progress for people and the planet, on the journey to net zero and beyond.  

More than 98,000 employees over 120 countries already started their SLB journeys. Start yours now!  

Aberdeen  

**Job Summary**
Field Engineer Trainees play a crucial role in our company’s growth by developing into future technical specialists, managers and leaders. This position provides the opportunity to build expertise in product knowledge, leadership, customer interaction and the delivery of engineering services accurately, safely and efficiently. As a Field Engineer Trainee, you will have opportunities to work towards professional membership with a relevant engineering institution. You will learn the business from the ground up, gaining the knowledge, skills and experience needed to become a skilled and confident specialist in your field.  

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing area of the business, supporting **Completions \& Well Intervention (CWI)** activities. You will join a small, collaborative team and undertake a structured training programme designed to develop your technical knowledge, field experience, customer\-facing skills and engineering capabilities. As you progress through your development and achieve the required technical competencies, you will have the opportunity to progress into a specialised CWI Engineering role, providing engineering and operational support for completion and well intervention activities.  

**Essential Responsibilities and Duties**
During the training program, your responsibilities will include:
* Ensure job deliverables are accurate and delivered on time.
* Supporting the planning and execution of completion, workover and well intervention operations.
* Supporting the preparation and review of Authorisations for Expenditure (AFEs)
* Develop an understanding of well integrity, well barriers, pressure control and applicable safety and regulatory requirements.
* Execute service delivery to the customer.
* Participate in job risk analysis and continual improvement programs.
* Develop customer contacts to promote company products and services.
* Ensure company and regulatory standard compliance by implementing the Compliance Assessment Tool (CAT), self\-assessments, and well site inspections.
* Participate in HSE and Quality initiatives.
* Wear PPE and observe HSE policies.
* Maintain the required safety training.
  

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Engineering. Candidates with degrees in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Petroleum, Process Engineering are particularly encouraged to apply.
* Be globally mobile.
* Willingness and ability to work in a field\-based and operational environment.
* The desire to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic business on high\-value, technically complex products/projects.
* The right to work in the United Kingdom.
  

**Preferred Skills**
* Strong interpersonal skills to communicate clearly and confidently.
* Be able to choose and initiate action.
* Be passionate about learning and research.
* Be eager to deliver results and meet demands.
* Remain positive during pressures, setbacks, and fast\-paced environments.
  

If this role is of interest to you and you are eager to learn more then we strongly encourage you to apply. We can then discuss how you will help shape and grow SLB moving forward  

**Why, as a graduate, should you join us**
* **Dynamic work environments**

The strength of our culture means you’ll work in a fast\-paced, supportive work environment. We offer hybrid working with a combination of on\-site \& home working days to achieve the right work\-life balance and allotted time for participating in volunteering and sustainability efforts.
* **Developing future leaders**

Become part of a community where your potential to lead is nurtured from the start. Joining us opens doors to leadership opportunities within our organization and across the broader industry, as evidenced by over 90% of our executive team who began their careers with us.
* **Borderless careers**

Our career\-building approach means you’ll have dedicated systems and an open, honest dialogue with managers and HR, helping you develop your career with potential opportunities across regions, functions and businesses.
* **Women in STEM**

Diversity is a key part of our success, and we have focused on gender balance for nearly 25 years. We are dedicated to nurturing and developing female talent both locally and globally. To support this goal, SLB has several initiatives, including mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company\-wide webinars, all aimed at helping women succeed.
* **Industry\-Leading Equipment**

Engage with cutting\-edge technology positioned at the forefront of the industry, contributing to pioneering advancements.  

**Benefits:**
* Competitive salary.
* We offer private healthcare for employees and their families as well as subsidised dental care.
* We provide well\-being programs such as Employee Mental health support and health and wellness coaching.
* Generous private employee\-funded pension contributions.
* Income protection scheme and life insurance.
* Cycle to work scheme.
* We have multiple internal employee resources groups, female mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company\-wide webinars, amongst other opportunities.

Other benefits are also available through the SLB flexible benefits program.  

**Flexible working**
We are open to flexible, hybrid working with a combination of on\-site \& home working days.  

**Certifications and Awards**
* We are proudly recognized as a disability\-confident, committed level employer.
* The Disability Equality Index awarded us the title of "Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion" in 2023\.
* Ranked among LinkedIn's "top companies in the UK for career development" for 2024\.
* Proud members of Business Disability Inn and the Valuable 500 initiative.
* Proudly ranked 4\.3 out of 5 on Glassdoor for Equality, Diversity and Inclusion.
* Proudly ranked 4\.1 out of 5 on Glassdoor for overall employee benefits.
* Proudly ranked 4\.2 out of 5 overall on Indeed.
  

**Still want to know more about SLB?**
Why not follow some of these useful links below to learn more about us directly from some of our employees?
* **Our People \- hear our stories**
* **Our Stories \- women in STEM**
  

*SLB is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or other characteristics protected by law. \#SLB*
 **Benefits**
------------

### **International Opportunities**


Global adventure, broad exposure, and limitless learning await you. You'll be part of the most multi\-cultural and diverse team of experts in any industry, anywhere.


### **Insurance**


Health, vision, and dental insurance for you and your dependents available from day one.


### **Learning Opportunities**


Global adventure, broad exposure, and limitless learning await you. You'll be part of the most multi\-cultural and diverse team of experts in any industry, anywhere.


### **Diverse and Inclusive**


Our exceptional and diverse people are the pulse and spirit of who we are. Every day, you will enrich your knowledge in an environment where differences in thought, creativity and experiences are embraced.


**About Us**
------------


We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all.


Global in outlook, local in practice – and with a united, shared passion for discovering solutions, we hire talented, driven people and support them to succeed, personally and professionally.

  

  

SLB is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.


We will endeavor to make a reasonable accommodation / modification to the known physical or mental limitations of a qualified applicant with a disability to assist in the hiring process, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local law. If you believe you require such assistance to complete this form or to participate in the interview process, please contact accommodationhotline@slb.com to request assistance. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to.


SLB is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor\- priority referral Protected Veterans requested.

Solna, Sweden


* Full\-time

* Tieto Caretech

  
Job Description **At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide employees in health regions and municipalities with product offerings that help them in their daily work, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.**

 **About us**


Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high\-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory\- and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

 **About the role**


The open position is with our DDC PRS product team. We provide personnel\- and workforce management solutions to health regions and municipalities. As a DevOps Engineer, you will have a close dialogue with our customers. Furthermore, you will work closely with our architects, developers and application specialists. It is important that you contribute to improving processes and further contribute to us creating solutions that meet the customers' needs and create value for them. We are looking for you who are outgoing, quality\-conscious and work in a structured and systematic manner.  

Good communication skills both in writing and orally are a requirement.

 **In this role you will mainly:**

* Install and upgrade Tieto Workforce Planner with associated applications in internal test environments and with existing and new customers.
* Carry out packaging, technical verification and delivery of new versions of the software.
* Help move on\-prem infrastructure to cloud both internal as well as customer installations.
* Contribute to maintaining Workforce Planner in a cloud environment
* Improve and automate solutions for software packaging, delivery and deployment of the product.
* Maintain and improve technical documentation for installation of the solution.
* Maintain internal environments.
* Carry out migration of the solutions from old to new servers when customers upgrade infrastructure.
* Assist technical operations staff at the customer when necessary.

 **Secondary you will:**

* Develop SQL scripts to meet the customer's needs for customized data extraction.
* Maintain and improve infrastructure for automated testing.
* Testing web service APIs.
* Optimize database queries.

 **It is an absolute requirement that you master both Norwegian and English fluently in writing and orally.**

 **We are looking for someone with:**

* 3\-year education in ICT.
	+ Relevant experience can compensate for a lack of formal education.
* Experience with:
	+ Azure DevOps and pipelines.
	+ Windows Server and management of rights, certificates.
	+ IIS and configuration of web applications.
	+ SQL Server and SQL script.
	+ PowerShell / bat\-scripting.
* Good communication skills

 **It would be beneficial if you also:**

* Version management systems such as Git.
* Container frameworks such as Docker.
* Programming skills in C\#.
* Testing web services with Bruno/Postman or similar tools.
* Infrastructure management on Azure.

 **AI knowledge requirement**


AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarizing, analyzing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

 **What’s in it for you?**

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing products beneficial for health regions and municipalities. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, an open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work\-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

 **Could you be our new colleague?**


We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Svein Johan Hauge, svein.johan.hauge@tieto.com

 *We perform background checks on all final candidates.*

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Flight Operations - Backend
new_jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer \- Flight Operations Backend**
=========================================================


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a leading role in the development of the Avinode Flight Operations product offering. As a member of a product team made up of a Product Manager, UX Designer, Test Lead, and Software Engineers, you will plan, implement, and release business\-critical features for customers across the business aviation industry.


**What you will do**

* Working together with your teammates, design appropriate technical solutions to implement new product features and improve current features. You will be working both in our existing C\# .NET monolith (with React frontend) as well as developing new services when needed.
* Maintain and improve the team’s CI/CD tooling, including cloud deployments to Azure.
* Work to bring our codebase up to date with current best practices, libraries, and platforms.
* Research and advocate for new technologies and techniques that would be beneficial to your team and/or the wider Engineering organisation.
* Act as a mentor to less experienced engineers as a technical resource to Avinode Group as a whole, providing information, advice, and technical assistance when requested.

**Who you are**

* You have 7\+ years of experience building systems with .Net Framework and .Net Core and some experience working with React frontends. You are more experienced with backend development, but you will be expected to contribute to all parts of the stack when necessary.
* You have 2\+ years experience with relational databases and related tooling such as ORMs. We use MS SQL Server, but experience with another major RDBMS such as Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, etc is fine.
* You have experience managing and securing resources in a major public cloud such as Azure (which we use), AWS, or GCP.
* You have a proven track record of leading projects, mentoring other members of your team, and researching and integrating new tools and technologies into your work.
* You are familiar with software development and delivery best practices, and know how to ensure your team is following them.
* You communicate well. With offices in multiple time zones and multiple countries, this position requires strong written and verbal communication skills.

new_jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

  

We are looking for a passionate and motivated Software Development Engineer I to join the Product Data Management (PDM) engineering team in Singapore.

  

The PDM team develops and maintains Autodesk's Product Data Management solutions, supporting customers worldwide in managing engineering design data across distributed environments. Our products include desktop and web applications, cloud services, file and database replication technologies, SDKs, CAD integrations, and enterprise\-scale solutions.

  

As a P1 Software Development Engineer, you will work alongside experienced engineers to design, develop, test, and maintain software features while building your technical expertise in enterprise software development.

 **Responsibilities**

* Develop, test, debug, and maintain software features under the guidance of senior engineers
